title: Junior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description – Junior Product Manager**

Company: DataShastra Technologies Private Limited

Location: Baner, Pune

Department: Tech

Website: https://datashastra.io

**About the Company**

DataShastra Technologies Private Limited builds technology-driven solutions, intelligent platforms, and SaaS products for the logistics industry. It is the new technology arm of Oorjaa, focused on monetizing our proprietary tech assets (TMS SaaS, Stocksense, Yeloplate).

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and analytical Junior Product Manager with 3–5 years of experience to drive product development, translate business requirements into product features, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Define and manage product requirements, features, and roadmaps aligned with business objectives.

\* Gather and analyze customer feedback, market trends, and business requirements.

\* Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and functional specifications.

\* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Business, and Operations teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

\* Prioritize product features and manage the product backlog based on business impact and customer needs.

\* Coordinate product releases, testing, and deployment to ensure timely delivery.

\* Monitor product performance using KPIs, user engagement metrics, and data analytics.

\* Identify opportunities for product enhancements and continuous improvement.

\* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify new opportunities.

\* Communicate product updates, priorities, and progress to relevant stakeholders.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

\* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

\* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Product Management, preferably in technology or SaaS-based companies.

\* Strong understanding of product development processes and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

\* Experience in writing PRDs, user stories, and functional specifications.

\* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

\* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management abilities.

\* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

\* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product management tools such as Jira or similar platforms.

\* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools is an advantage.

**What We’re Looking For**

\* A product-oriented mindset with a strong focus on customer needs and business outcomes.

\* Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical product solutions.

\* Strong ownership, execution, and prioritization skills.

\* Adaptability and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced technology environment.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at rashmee.alange@oorjaa.tech

title: Digital Product Manager -VP
description:
Join us as a Senior Digital Product Owner - Digital Help & AI at Barclays where you'll be responsible for owning and enhancing the Digital Help experience across the mobile banking app and digital channels, with a focus on self-service tools and customer support journeys. You'll work closely with Product Owners and Product Managers to deliver activities that improve how customers access help and support digitally. This role will support the launch and evolution of integrated AI capabilities, including new features within the app and AI-assisted experiences. You'll take ownership of the customer journey, ensuring digital help solutions are intuitive, effective, and aligned to customer needs.
  
  
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful as a Senior Digital Product Owner - Digital Help & AI, you must have the following essential skills:
  
  
  

* Product ownership: Experience identifying customer needs through data and research, prioritising problems to solve based on business and customer value, and owning products from discovery through to post-launch optimisation.
* Delivery expertise: Proven ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both live customer journeys and new features.
* Data literacy: Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear and concise insights or business cases.
* Risk and controls: Understanding of risk and control frameworks, with the ability to ensure effective risk management and mitigation throughout product delivery.
* Stakeholder management: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams - including engineers, designers, intelligence teams, and control functions - and stakeholders across the UK and India.
* Financial services experience: Experience working within the financial services industry, with an understanding of the UK regulatory, risk, and customer environment.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* AI Knowledge: Understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI products, including awareness of the governance, risk, and control frameworks required to deliver these solutions safely and responsibly

  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
  
  
This role is based in Pune, India.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To manage and drive the innovation strategy to meet customer needs and ensure the bank's long-term success and competitive edge.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Execution of market research to understand customer needs, pain points, and emerging trends to support the analysis of profitability, market size and positioning for new products compared to existing offerings, and to identify opportunities for diversification to gain a competitive advantage.
* Collaboration with stakeholders across departments and teams including marketing, sales, technology, engineers, designers etc to generate innovative and feasible product ideas and prototypes for testing aligned with customer needs and strategic goals.
* Development of concepts and specifications which define features, functionalities, target market, user interface, technical specifications and potential revenue models of new products.
* Evaluation of the technical feasibility, legal compliance, and potential risks associated with the development and launch of the new product.
* Monitoring of market trends and analysis feedback from internal employees and target customers through prototypes, user testing sessions, and beta programs to identify areas for improvement to refine the product before launch.
* Management of comprehensive launch plans and technical deployments for products that establish rollout timelines, marketing strategies, training initiatives and communication channels to promote the launch new products effectively.
* Monitoring of key metrics such as adoption rates, usage patterns, customer satisfaction, and revenue generation to assess the product's performance against set goals.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Platform and Digital Enablement Lead - GRC
description:
**About the Role:**
We are looking for an experienced
**Platform and Digital Enablement Lead - Governance, Risk and Control**
to lead the digital enablement of our Governance, Risk and Control (GRC) landscape.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on delivery role responsible for bringing together GRC platforms, digital workflows, AI and automation, data quality, self-service capabilities and user adoption. The role will own the integrated product roadmap and lead the Platform, Digital Enablement and Data Quality team, while personally driving complex cross-product initiatives.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in translating GRC standards and strategy into scalable, governed and user-focused digital solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and drive the integrated roadmap and prioritized portfolio across GRC platforms, workflows, AI, continuous controls monitoring, digital guidance, learning, adoption and data quality.
* Translate GRC strategy and approved framework requirements into clear capabilities, sequenced releases, dependencies, resource requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Lead and develop Platform Managers, Digital Enablement Managers and the Data Quality Manager, establishing clear product ownership and delivery standards.
* Personally lead complex initiatives that bring together platform, data, AI, workflow, controls and adoption requirements.
* Act as the senior functional product authority for the GRC digital landscape, ensuring standardization, architecture alignment, auditability and a strong end-to-end user experience.
* Govern portfolio intake, business cases, prioritization, design decisions, acceptance criteria, testing, release readiness, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with engineering teams on build capacity, technical dependencies, operational support, incident resolution and sustainable product ownership.
* Establish robust data-quality rules, reconciliations, ownership and exception processes to support trusted workflows, analytics and management reporting.
* Establish responsible AI and automation guardrails, including appropriate human oversight, traceability, explainability and quality controls.

**Core Comptencies:**

* Proven leadership experience managing enterprise GRC platforms, preferably SAP GRC solutions, and digital product portfolios.
* Deep expertise in GRC processes, controls, workflow design, and governance architecture.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI, automation, and continuous controls monitoring capabilities at scale.
* Strong knowledge of SAP GRC Process Control, including data governance, data quality, and management reporting.
* Ability to lead and develop teams while personally driving complex cross-functional transformation and adoption initiatives.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience, with significant experience across GRC, digital platforms, technology-enabled transformation, product management, risk, controls or related areas.
* Strong experience in digital product and portfolio leadership, including roadmap prioritization and value management.
* Good understanding of GRC platforms, workflow architecture and digitally enabled risk and compliance processes.
* Experience working with AI and automation, with an understanding of responsible governance, human oversight, traceability and quality controls.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality and associated controls.
* Experience driving digital adoption, self-service capabilities and service design.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across business and technology teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong people leadership capabilities, combined with the ability and willingness to remain hands-on in the delivery of complex initiatives.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships:**
The role will work closely with:
  
  

* Head of GRC Standards, Platform and Reporting
* Platform Managers
* Digital Enablement Managers
* Data Quality Manager
* Governance & Standard and Data & Reporting roles
* Product, Platform and Engineering teams
* GPLs, FPOs and first-line users
* PEX, A&I and external auditors

**Measures of Success:**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

* Delivery of portfolio milestones
* Requirement-to-release cycle time
* Release quality and critical defects
* Platform availability and incident trends
* Self-service and active adoption
* Data-quality rule pass rates
* Reduction in manual effort
* User confidence and support demand

**What You Will Be Accountable For:**
You will be accountable for maintaining an integrated and prioritized roadmap across platform, AI, self-service, adoption and data quality; ensuring the functional quality, usability, auditability and adoption of GRC digital products; maintaining reliable data controls; and ensuring responsible governance of AI and automation with appropriate human oversight

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Senior Delivery Lead - Product Delivery
description:
Job Title: Senior Delivery Lead - Product Delivery

analytics, the Internet of Things, and user design thinking to deliver on the promise of
  
  
intelligent buildings and smart cities that connect communities in ways that make
  
  
people’s lives – and the world – better & safer.

India, reporting into Senior Data Product Manager. He/she will be responsible for
  
  
defining the delivery and support for applications utilizing Snowflake, Azure and related
  
  
data tools. As a Data Product Manager, you are responsible for managing Data Product
  
  
Delivery and Support team. This role requires strong relationships with business
  
  
stakeholders and key staff members to clearly understand the overall business
  
  
objectives and functional process requirements. This role is responsible for translating
  
  
the business requirements into an functional data product. This position must be able
  
  
to work across organizational boundaries to manage the successful execution of
  
  
projects and initiatives, ensuring on schedule, on-quality, and on-budget project
  
  
performance. This role will provide oversight and direction to the data product delivery
  
  
staff aligned to each project. You will be liaising with other IT departments, gather cost/
  
  
time estimates and propose these to the business customers giving them a full
  
  
overview on cost, process, and timings.
  
  
How you will do it
  
  

* Lead and manage technical and solution delivery resources for projects.
* Ensure functional and technical governance is in place.

Technical Architects and CoE teams for the successful delivery

areas of responsibility.
  
  

* Work with architecture and operations departments to ensure that Data

products follow company standards at a high level of availability.
  
  

* Support the analysis of designs, developing, testing and implementing changes

to the Data product.
  
  

* Lead the results of the testing cycle of system design changes prior to migrating

to Production environment.
  
  

* Cooperate with Release Manager to resolve readiness and deployment schedule

of the data product modifications or enhancements.
  
  

* Supports the solution migration strategy for moving changes between

environments.
  
  

* Work with the external application vendors on issue resolution, enhancements,

and improvements.
  
  

* Act as liaison between Corp IT and the business teams.
* Partner with ePMO, Delivery organization & IT business partners to ensure tight

governance, high velocity & cost-efficient delivery of Data Solutions.
  
  

* Demonstrate an understanding of concepts, best practices & functions to

implement Data Solutions.
  
  

* Connect with management to limit any uncontrolled expansion of work.
* Drive values & behaviors to ensure compliance, integrity & financial

commitment.
  
  

* Work with remote-working teams based globally.

What we look for
  
  

* BE/ B.Tech in Software Engineering/Computer Science or similar
* Overall, 10+ years of professional experience.
* 15+ yrs. of hands-on experience using various development methodologies to

deliver Data Solutions on the data platform. Snowflake experience is preferred.
  
  

* Validated expertise of the following:
* Big Data Analytics, Cloud Data platforms
* Proven record in multiple successful deliveries of data solution projects in all

sizes.
  
  

* Success in leading & mentoring diverse teams.
* Experience working on projects with Integrations or data warehouse.
* Highly organized with strong prioritization and documentation skills
* Outstanding communication, written and interpersonal skills.
* Strong leadership, influencing & collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching & mentoring individuals and teams.

**Essential Skills**

* Manage resolution of interpersonal conflicts and issues beyond the team’s

authority to keep team passionate about goals and objectives, within a highly
  
  
global matrix setup.
  
  

* Foster a culture of technical discipline, craftsmanship, and innovation.
* Drive continuous improvement by facilitating team retrospectives, teaching

problem-solving techniques, and driving greater accountability among team
  
  
members.
  
  

* Hold accountability for team’s commitments, and in cases of failure,

communicate failure points, repercussions, and mitigating plans.

formal organizational control.

description:
**Business Title: Engineering Manager**
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model,
**2-3 days in the office**
. You will be required to interview in person.

**About SailPoint**
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.
  
Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.
  
  
**About the Role**
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and empower a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for owning the technical development of SailPoint’s core product capabilities. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, write and review quality code, debug complex distributed systems issues, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous delivery. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with US-based teams and stakeholders to build and maintain cloud-native, event-driven microservices on AWS.
  
  
**About the Team**
At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. We are a results-driven crew built on innovation, collaboration, and mutual trust. Our team designs and deploys scalable, enterprise-grade identity security products powered by mature cloud architecture and cutting-edge technologies.
  
  

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* **15+ years of experience in software engineering**
  , with demonstrated experience building, leading, and managing teams of software engineers
* Strong foundational understanding of
  **software development, particularly in Java,**
  as well as modern front-end architectures.
* Proven track record of success delivering complex software solutions in an Agile development environment
* Solid foundation in software engineering principles, distributed systems, and cloud architecture (AWS preferred)
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills with a passion for continuous improvement
* Strong project management abilities with experience scoping, prioritizing, tracking, and delivering engineering milestones
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones
* Willingness to maintain at least 4 overlapping working hours with US time zones

**AI-assisted engineering:**
Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.
  
  
**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code
* Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy
* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch
* LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar

**Roadmap for Success**

**30 Days:**

* Complete SailPoint onboarding, understand our identity security product suite, and get familiar with the cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted on AWS.
* Establish relationships with your engineering team, Product Management partners, and US-based counterparts.
* Understand the current sprint commitments, team workflows, and active technical priorities.

**60 Days:**

* Assume day-to-day leadership of the engineering team and run Agile ceremonies effectively.
* Actively partner with Product Management to review roadmaps, scope incoming projects, and allocate engineering resources.
* Begin coaching and setting clear performance objectives for direct reports through regular 1:1 mentorship sessions.

**90 Days:**

* Own end-to-end project planning, tracking, and risk management for your team's deliverables and key milestones.
* Maintain a seamless communication cadence with global stakeholders, ensuring overlapping collaboration with the US team.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process or architectural improvements to raise code quality and team velocity.

**6 Months:**

* Drive the successful release of high-impact features and architectural enhancements to production on AWS.
* Foster a strong culture of career development, mentoring engineers toward their next career milestones.
* Proactively manage technical risk, system reliability, and resource allocation across multiple simultaneous initiatives.

**1 Year:**

* Establish a proven track record of predictable, high-quality product delivery that advances SailPoint’s identity security platform.
* Scale team capabilities, mentor emerging leaders, and contribute strategic engineering input toward long-term product roadmaps.

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits**
:
  
Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

title: Product Manager, Senior
description:
**Company overview:**
TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.
  
  
Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
  
  
Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
  
  
**Senior Product Manager Canonical Transactions**
Multi Enterprise Interoperability and B2B Integration | Pune India | TraceLink
  
  
**Role purpos**
e
  
  
TraceLink is seeking a Senior Product Manager to define and scale reusable canonical transaction models for multi-enterprise value chains. The role converts complex business workflows and heterogeneous partner messages into standards-aligned, implementation-ready product specifications that can be reused across industries, customers, partners, applications, and integration technologies.
  
  
This person will operate at the intersection of product management, multi-enterprise business processes, B2B standards, enterprise applications, and data modeling. Success requires more than gathering requirements: the role must determine the business meaning of a transaction, reconcile industry standards and customer variants, define a durable canonical model, and guide that model through subtype design, transforms, user experience, testing, release, adoption, and lifecycle governance. The resulting models must work across Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Logistics, Medical devices, Healthcare, Food and Beverage, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, and other partner-intensive industries.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* A portfolio of canonical transactions across order management, procurement, planning, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, logistics, transportation, customs, finance, master data, and operational messaging.
* Research the end-to-end business process, including how a transaction is generated and triggered, sender and receiver roles, expected response, exception paths, regulatory implications, and system-of-record behavior for each transaction.
* Normalize equivalent business concepts across such global data standards as JSon and XML, ANSI X12, SAP IDoc, UN/EDIFACT and EANCOM, GS1, ODETTE and VDA, UBL and Peppol, and a variety of ERP system APIs while preserving source-specific semantics, version differences, qualifiers, and implementation constraints.
* Define canonical object structures, reusable components, identifiers, references, parties, locations, dates, quantities, amounts, statuses, code lists, conditions, loops, cardinality, and validation rules.,
* Design canonical schema data structures for reuse across partner roles such as buyers, suppliers, manufacturers, contract manufacturers, distributors, warehouses, 3PLs and 4PLs, carriers, automotive OEMs and tier suppliers, retailers, marketplaces, dealers, service providers, customs participants, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Produce canonical designs and documentation, field-level mapping specifications, business rules, sample JSON and XML payloads, subtype requirements, picklists or enumerations, and transformation acceptance criteria.
* Create detailed specifications for transformations between global data standards and TraceLink canonical structures for both inbound and outbound interfaces across a complete range of transactions and business processes, including formats for standard LinkActions that drive connectivity to major ERP systems, reference-data conversion, test data, system reconciliation, and error handling.
* Perform gap analysis against customer and industry implementation guidelines, sample messages, ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, and commerce-platform structures, and existing TraceLink canonicals; distinguish true canonical gaps from mapping, configuration, reference-data, or source-data issues.
* Partner with Architecture and Engineering on schema design tradeoffs, extensibility, backward compatibility, versioning, performance, UI depth constraints, and migration strategy.
* Create, groom, and prioritize system documentation in Epics and Stories. Define acceptance criteria; review implementations; support QA automation and regression testing with representative customer files, and release readiness.
* Govern the transaction lifecycle by assessing enhancement requests, preventing customer-specific overfitting, maintaining compatibility, standardizing code lists, and measuring reuse, adoption, defects, and delivery speed.
* Serve as the product expert for customers and internal teams, supporting discovery, design reviews, implementation decisions, demos, enablement, and roadmap prioritization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of product management, business analysis, solution architecture, integration consulting, or standards implementation experience in multi-enterprise supply chains, B2B integration, ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, commerce, or manufacturing platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to model complex business transactions and translate process semantics into structured schemas, mappings, validation rules, and testable requirements.
* Working knowledge of at least two enterprise B2B formats or integration ecosystems, such as JSon and XML, ANSI X12, SAP IDoc, UN/EDIFACT, EANCOM, GS1, cXML, OAGIS, ODETTE and VDA, UBL and Peppol, APIs, or ERP-native business objects.
* Strong understanding of multi-enterprise flows across master data, forecasts, orders, schedules, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, fulfillment, shipping, receiving, transportation, invoicing, settlement, traceability, and exception handling.
* Ability to read implementation guidelines and sample payloads at segment, element, qualifier, loop, and cardinality level and explain their business meaning to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience working with Architecture, Engineering, UX, QA, Services, and customer-facing teams through discovery, specification, delivery, validation, and release.
* Strong analytical judgment: can separate a reusable product requirement from customer-specific configuration and make explicit tradeoffs around scope, compatibility, and time to market.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise product requirements, design reviews, customer workshops, executive updates, and enablement content.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in one or more partner-intensive industries such as Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Logistics, Medical devices, Healthcare, Food and Beverage, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, and other partner-intensive or regulated industries.
* Exposure to such cross-industry concerns as traceability, product and location identification, quality, customs, sustainability, cold chain, recalls, or regulatory compliance is valuable.
* Hands-on familiarity with enterprise processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, forecast-to-fulfill, plan-to-produce, inventory and warehouse management, transportation, product information, and financial settlement.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, PIM, marketplace, or commerce platforms is valuable.
* Experience designing canonical or common data models, API resources, event schemas, master-data structures, reference-data management, or schema governance.
* Experience with transformation development and practices using such integration tools as Contivo, IBM Sterling Integrator, SAP Integration Suite, bizTalk and others, including creating mapping specifications and code-list conversions, test harnesses, automated regression, and exception reconciliation.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS, metadata-driven applications, configurable business objects, extensibility, release management, and backward-compatible schema evolution.
* Familiarity with analytics, reports, dashboards, AI assistants or agents, and the data quality and explainability needed to make transactional data usable for decisions and automation.
* Coding experience in any programming language in an enterprise environment is a desirable bonus.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Canonicals accurately represent the business process and support targeted industries, standards, partner roles, regions, and implementation patterns.
* New customer or partner mappings reuse standard canonical structures and code lists with minimal one-off extensions.
* Transaction research, canonical specifications, sample payloads, and acceptance criteria are complete enough for Engineering and QA to implement without repeated interpretation.
* Canonical and subtype defects, escaped mapping gaps, and backward-compatibility issues decline release over release. Time to research, design, build, validate, and deploy a new transaction or standard LinkAction improves measurably.
* Internal and customer teams can understand, demonstrate, implement, and extend the transaction portfolio with confidence.

What strong candidates demonstrate
  
  
During interviews, strong candidates should be able to work through a realistic transaction rather than rely only on general product-management language. A practical case may ask the candidate to:
  
  

* Explain the business purpose and choreography of a transaction, including initiator, responder, system of record, acknowledgements, and exception paths.
* Compare the same business concept across an X12 message, an EDIFACT message, and an SAP IDoc or API, identifying semantic mismatches rather than performing a superficial field match.
* Propose a canonical structure with reusable components, identifiers, references, quantities, statuses, enumerations, conditions, and extension points.
* Assess a customer sample against an existing canonical and classify gaps as product, mapping, reference-data, configuration, or source-data concerns.
* Define validation rules, representative test scenarios, backward-compatibility considerations, and success measures.

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Manager, Product Management - Integrations
description:

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

This role provides technical and delivery oversight across the IAIS (Industry AI Solutions) portfolio of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions. The Product Engineering Lead assesses, solution by solution, whether each is being built as per the roadmap, at the expected quality, architecture and readiness, and then carries the best practices, reusable patterns and lessons from one solution to the others.

The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and delivery. It works with IAIS Product Managers on what the roadmap commits to, with solution delivery teams and architects on how it is being built, and with program governance on how progress is reported. When a delivery team hits an operational or technical problem, this role brings the right expertise and the proven fix, so the team keeps moving.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Portfolio Review & Roadmap Conformance***

* **Review multiple IAIS solutions concurrently**
  through a structured review cadence (design, build-progress, release-readiness and post-release reviews), judging each against its roadmap commitments, scope, timelines and quality bar.
* **Detect drift early:**
  identify slippage, scope creep, architectural deviation, dependency gaps and technical debt, and agree corrective actions with the Product Manager and delivery lead.
* **Track portfolio health**
  through a consistent set of delivery and engineering KPIs (roadmap adherence, release predictability, quality and defect trends, incident and cost trends) and publish a portfolio view for program governance and senior stakeholders.

***Technical Assurance***

* **Assess solution architecture and engineering practice**
  for scalability, security, integration (including hyperscaler services), observability and maintainability.
* **Apply AI / Agentic AI readiness checkpoints**
  (evaluation metrics, guardrails and responsible-AI checks, quality gates, deployment and ops readiness) so that releases are repeatable and ship with confidence.
* **Review operational risk:**
  hallucination and quality issues, latency and token cost, data and integration failures, and production stability for solutions already live.

***Best-Practice Translation & Enablement***

* **Identify what works**
  in one solution (architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, prompt/agent design, LLMOps and CI/CD practices, accelerators) and translate it into reusable playbooks, reference architectures and standards for the other solutions.
* **Spread learning across teams**
  by running communities of practice, review forums and targeted coaching for delivery leads and engineers on GenAI / Agentic AI engineering and delivery.
* **Help teams solve operational problems**
  as and when they arise by pointing them to proven solutions, bringing in subject-matter experts, and capturing the resolution for the wider portfolio.

***Stakeholder & Team Leadership***

* **Work with IAIS Product Managers and delivery leads**
  to align roadmap, technical feasibility and delivery priorities, and to surface cross-solution dependencies and shared-platform needs.
* **Guide and mentor the solution delivery leads and architects**
  across the portfolio; set expectations on delivery discipline and engineering quality, and give feedback on their performance.
* **Escalate clearly:**
  raise risks and decisions with options and recommendations to program governance and senior leadership.

**Qualifications**

***Must have***

* BE/B.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MBA / PG is a plus.
* 12+ years in IT services, product engineering or platform delivery, with a progression through developer, architect and delivery roles; has led or overseen more than one solution or team at a time.
* Strong technical grounding, enough to challenge architecture, code quality and engineering practice credibly: APIs and microservices, data pipelines, CI/CD, containers, observability and security.
* Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler's cloud and AI services and how they integrate with enterprise systems.
* Working knowledge of GenAI / Agentic AI solutions in production: LLM integration, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, LLMOps.
* Experience running review and governance mechanisms (design reviews, stage gates, release-readiness checks) across several concurrent programs.
* Proven ability to codify and transfer best practices across teams, such as playbooks, standards and reference architectures.

***Good to have***

* Experience in a product-company or product-engineering environment, working with product managers on roadmaps and releases.
* Experience with LLMOps/MLOps, model-evaluation tooling and agent interoperability standards (e.g. MCP).
* Hyperscaler AI certification(s) and/or PMP / Scrum / SAFe certification.
* Exposure to responsible-AI, data privacy and compliance requirements for enterprise AI.

**Expected Impact**

* Solutions across the IAIS portfolio are built as per roadmap, with early detection of drift and fewer late surprises.
* Consistent engineering quality and release readiness across solutions, rather than strong in some and weak in others.
* Best practices and lessons learned travel quickly between solutions, reducing rework and raising team capability.
* Delivery teams resolve operational and technical problems faster because proven fixes and experts are readily available.
* Stakeholders have a single, credible, KPI-driven view of portfolio delivery health.

**Skills**

Solution Portfolio Review, Roadmap Conformance Tracking, Technical Assurance, GenAI / Agentic AI Architecture Understanding, Hyperscaler / Cloud Integration, Best-Practice Codification, Delivery Governance, Technical Problem Solving, Coaching & Mentoring, Product-Engineering Partnership, Risk/Issue Management, KPI & Metrics Reporting, Stakeholder Management

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.
  
  
We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent

**What makes you stand out:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. title: Director of Engineering Consumer Intelligence & Engagement
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
As Director of Engineering - Consumer Intelligence & Engagement, you'll be a product-aligned technology leader with direct accountability for engineering delivery across the capabilities that define how consumers discover, engage with, and respond to our brand. You'll own the full product technology lifecycle, from architecture decisions and roadmap execution to engineering standards and platform health.
  
  
Your organisation is the layer of intelligence and engagement that brings our core commerce capabilities to life: shaping what consumers see, how content reaches them, how products are discovered, and how campaigns convert. AI is a key enabler here - you'll apply it to sharpen personalisation, accelerate content workflows, improve product discovery, and build smarter campaign targeting - but strong software engineering depth across these product domains remains the primary craft.
  
  
As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office-based and require regular in-person collaboration to accelerate decision-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world-class engineering capability from the ground up.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:**

* Personalisation - consumer segmentation, behavioural targeting, AI-driven product recommendations, and next-best-action experiences.
* Consumer Communication - email, push notifications, SMS, and in-app messaging delivery, personalisation, and orchestration.
* Promotions & Campaigns – personalised promotions, offer management, campaign targeting, scheduling, and performance instrumentation.
* Discovery & Conversion Optimisation – search and discovery platforms, consumer engagement, experimentation, and conversion optimisation capabilities.

**Technology Vision & Product Roadmap Delivery**

* Own the technology strategy and engineering roadmap across all Consumer Intelligence & Engagement capabilities, in close partnership with the product organisation.
* Drive end-to-end delivery accountability: architecture decisions, engineering execution, quality assurance, release management, and production health across the full capability portfolio.

**Personalisation, Product Discovery & Conversion Optimisation**

* Lead the engineering design and delivery of personalisation capabilities such as consumer segmentation logic, affinity modelling integrations, and real-time recommendation surfaces on PDP, PLP, homepage, and campaign pages.
* Build the technical foundation for A/B testing, multivariate experimentation, and feature flagging across personalisation and discovery surfaces, enabling rigorous data-driven optimisation.
* Define and own the data contract between consumer event infrastructure and personalisation/ranking systems, including schema standards, latency requirements, and completeness in partnership with data engineering and analytics.

**Promotions, Campaigns & Consumer Communications**

* Lead the engineering of promotions and campaign management - rules engine configuration and extension within SFCC, offer scheduling, eligibility logic, and storefront rendering of promotional content.
* Own the technical architecture for consumer communication systems - integration with messaging platforms (email, push, SMS), personalisation of communication content, and event-triggered automation.
* Apply AI to campaign and promotions engineering: intelligent audience segmentation, send-time optimisation, and AI-assisted copy generation for targeted consumer communications.

**Architecture, Standards & Governance**

* Define and govern the software architecture for all capability domains, ensuring solutions are scalable, composable, and well-integrated with the shared commerce technology platform.
* Partner closely with the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation to align on shared components, design system usage, and front-end standards.

**Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of senior engineers and manage delivery partners.
* Foster a product engineering culture - engineers who take ownership of outcomes, not just outputs, and who engage deeply with consumer and business problems.
* Build strong working relationships with Product, UX, Marketing, Merchandising, and Data teams to ensure engineering is a genuine business partner across all capability areas.

**YOUR TALENT:**
**Key Requirements:**

* 15+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior engineering leadership with direct product delivery accountability.
* Proven track record delivering consumer engagement, personalisation, product discovery, promotions, campaigns and consumer communication capabilities in a DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) or retail environment.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) or equivalent - commerce APIs, catalogue management, promotions framework, and extension patterns will be a plus.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into consumer-facing products such as recommendations, search relevance, content generation and personalisation.
* Experience delivering recommendation and personalisation capabilities at scale with low latency service layer - model integration, evaluation, optimisation and operationalisation.
* Experience designing and scaling experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging and data-driven optimisation.
* Track record of building and governing engineering standards across multi-team product organisations.
* Experience in fashion, sports, or lifestyle retail DTC organisations.
* Background with search & merchandising platforms.
* Familiarity with marketing automation and communications platforms.
* Working knowledge of AI/LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models) applied to content enrichment or commerce use cases.
* Demonstrated adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, software quality and efficiency.

**Leadership Expectations:**
At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking & Vision**

* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.

**Ownership & Accountability**

* Take end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a strong focus on results
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain diverse, high-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
* Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
* Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
* Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
* Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
* Demonstrate confidence in decision-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
* Lead with a team-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.

**Innovation & Continuous Learning**

* Champion modern engineering practices, AI-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
* Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.

**Commercial & Consumer Mindset**

* Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
* Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
* Maintain a strong consumer-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
* Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.

**Building PUMA's Future**

* Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.

Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
description:
**Job Description**
Our Purpose
  
  
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Title and Summary
  
  
Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value.
* Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready.
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize.
* Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not.
* Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation.
* Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus

what requires a platform build.
  
  

* Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes.
* Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients.
* Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built.
* Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage.
* Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning.
* Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon.
* Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker.
* Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:

**About Springer Nature**
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.
  
  
At Springer Nature, we recognise that great talent develops through many different paths. We encourage applications from individuals with strong transferable skills, provided they are supported by relevant experience that shows how those skills have been successfully applied in practice. Our hiring approach balances skills, experience, and potential to ensure each role is fulfilled with both short term effectiveness and long term growth in mind.
  
  
**About The Team**
Springer Nature’s Group Publishing Operations team (GPO) performs and oversees manuscript screening operations across Springer Nature's journals portfolio. GPO also manages the various peer-review systems used by authors, editors and reviewers as part of submit-to-accept processes.
  
  
Our 'article-level' activities are largely supported by 400+ BPO staff across multiple locations. Our 'journal-level' activities are largely supported by :50 Springer Nature staff across multiple locations, who also contribute to projects in one of three main areas: technology, transformation and quality.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Implementation Specialist will manage their own portfolio of journals and partner with Publishing teams to run their journals in a ‘Production-ready’ way, while facilitating submit-to-accept workflows and compliance with policies.
  
  
In collaboration with the Manager, Quality Assurance (as well as the rest of the Quality Assurance team and the wider GPO team), the Implementation Specialist will also contribute to GPO’s quality assurance programme (proactively and reactively addressing quality issues), with the aim of delivering best-in-class quality levels across GPO.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities:**
*Journal care*

* Gather system requirements from publishers, editors and service providers.
* Set up, maintain and administrate peer review systems.
* Conduct presentations and training sessions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure quality of article-level activities and act as an escalation point for individual journals.
* Develop and maintain relationships with stakeholders (Publishing, Editorial, Production, Technology & Operations staff, as well as external editors, reviewers, authors and service providers).
* Maintain journal-specific records and documentation.

*Quality Assurance*

* Collaborate with GPO’s Automation & Analysis team to gather meaningful and reliable quality-related insights.
* Proactively monitor quality across journals and investigate issues surfaced by the monitoring, as well as ones reported by stakeholders.
* Collaborate with GPO service providers, other Implementation Specialists, as well as GPO’s Workflow Solutions and Training Programmes teams, to ensure the underlying causes of quality issues are addressed.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Be an advocate for continuous improvement, quality and efficiency. Foster a culture of openness, transparency and collaboration within the team and with our stakeholders.

**Experience, Skills & Qualifications:**
**Essential**

* Contributing to (sometimes interconnected) business projects.
* Working with a wide range of global stakeholders.
* Excellent organisation skills to contribute to multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate with individuals at all levels and on a global scale.
* Excellent numeracy skills with proven attention to detail.
* Excel and PowerPoint proficiency.
* Good problem solving/logic/analytical skills.
* Proactive and able to lead projects alone as well as part of a large group.
* Degree or equivalent work experience.

*Desirable*

* Previous experience in a publishing and/or support role.
* Understanding of publishing workflows.
* Business analysis and data analysis.
* Formal project management qualification such as PRINCE2
