title: Customer Experience Process Expert 1 1
description:
**Shape the Future with Us.**
At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.
  
  
As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.
  
  
The Global Business Process Expert (BPX) is accountable for designing, standardizing, and evolving the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) event-driven operating model. This role plays a critical part in a multi-year transformation to shift from traditional order entry to a proactive, exception-based customer service model enabled by automation, advanced workflows, and AI-driven insights.
  
  
The Global BPE partners closely with the Global Process Owner to define new ways of working that fundamentally change how work is performed, introducing event orchestration, touchless order processing, and real-time intervention capabilities. This includes designing global standards, governance frameworks, and scalable process models that drive consistency across regions while improving service reliability, speed, and cost efficiency.
  
  
To ensure these standards remain relevant and effective, the Global BPX actively incorporates feedback from Regional BPXs into the evolution of global standards. This role combines process design, transformation execution, and technology enablement, ensuring that future-state processes are not only well-defined but also practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Process Design & Transformation**

* Design and document future-state O2C processes, emphasizing event-driven orchestration and exception-based execution.
* Embed new ways of working that shift teams from transactional processing to proactive event management.
* Set global standards for touchless order processing, intelligent exception handling, and consistent customer outcomes.

**Event & Exception Framework**

* Develop and maintain a global event taxonomy (e.g., order failures, credit blocks, supply and delivery risks).
* Define event triggers, thresholds, prioritization logic, and escalation paths to enable timely intervention.
* Create standardized response playbooks to ensure consistent issue handling and resolution across regions.

**Technology & Digital Enablement**

* Partner with IT and transformation teams to enable processes through ERP, CRM, and workflow platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Dynamics 365).
* Support the implementation of case management, automated workflows, and real-time alerting to manage exceptions at scale.
* Contribute to AI and analytics use cases that improve visibility, predict risk, and enable proactive issue resolution.

**Governance & Global Alignment**

* Establish governance frameworks that drive adherence to global process standards and controls.
* Align Regional BPEs to common methodologies, artifacts, and practices to ensure consistent execution across regions.
* Serve as a central point of expertise for process design decisions, trade-offs, and standard interpretations.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define global KPIs (e.g., touchless rate, event resolution time, cycle time, cost-to-serve) and standard reporting definitions.
* Analyze cross-regional performance trends to identify systemic issues, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase automation, reduce manual effort, and improve service reliability.

**Change & Adoption Support**

* Support development of training materials, playbooks, and communications to enable adoption of new processes and tools.
* Partner with regional teams to drive readiness, deployment, and sustained adoption of standardized ways of working.
* Reinforce a culture of standardization, accountability, and continuous improvement across the O2C community.

**Requirements**
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 10+ years Customer Experience, Order to Cash, or related roles, with global or multi-region process leadership.
* 5+ years of experience leading or coordinating global process improvement or governance initiatives.
* Extensive hands-on experience with SAP Order-to-Cash modules in a global context.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong project management and process governance skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
* Ability to drive global standardization and harmonization.
* Analytical mindset with expertise in continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI).

**Considered a Plus**

* Knowledge of Lubrizol’s global product portfolio and international regulatory environments.
* Experience working in a highly matrixed, multinational organization.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or APICS certification.

**Travel**

* Minimal travel may be required for training or meetings. Any travel requirements will be communicated in advance and will adhere to company travel policies.

**Lubrizol: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science. ™ Delivered by You.**
For nearly 100 years, The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, has been at the forefront of innovation to enhance everyday life, advance mobility, and make the modern world work better. Our specialty chemistry solutions—from engine oils, performance coatings, and skincare to medical devices and plumbing systems —are powered by the expertise, passion, and commitment of people like you. We tackle the world’s toughest challenges with science-based solutions, deeply understanding our customers to deliver innovative chemistry and differentiated value. Our inclusive culture, dedication to safety, and incredible global talent drive our success. Our solutions meet the evolving needs of the modern world—brought to life by science and, most importantly, delivered by you. Whether you're in the lab, on the production floor, or in the office, you'll be part of a team around the world that empowers you to think boldly, drive results, and contribute to solutions that shape a better, more sustainable future.  We win because of you. Let’s build the future together.

title: NPD & Procurement Specialist
company: CITTA (Lexicon Lifestyle - A Lexicon Group Enterprise)
description:
* **About CITTA**
* CITTA is a growing Indian skincare and personal care brand built on the philosophy of combining modern science with the wisdom of Indian traditions. We develop thoughtful, quality-driven products across skincare, bath and body, and personal care, with a focus on product efficacy, ingredient transparency, and consumer needs.
* We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented
  **NPD & Procurement Specialist**
  to manage the end-to-end new product development process while ensuring timely, cost-effective, and quality-driven sourcing of raw materials, packaging components, and finished products.
* **About the Role**
* The NPD & Procurement Specialist will be responsible for coordinating new product development from concept to commercialisation, working closely with product development teams, third-party manufacturers, vendors, quality assurance, regulatory teams, and internal stakeholders.
* The role will involve identifying suitable suppliers, sourcing ingredients and packaging, coordinating sampling and product trials, negotiating commercial terms, tracking development timelines, and ensuring that products meet CITTA’s quality, cost, and launch requirements.
* Key Responsibilities
* **1. New Product Development (NPD)**
* Coordinate the end-to-end development of new skincare, bath and body, and personal care products from concept to launch.
* Work with internal teams and third-party manufacturers to develop product briefs, specifications, formulations, and packaging requirements.
* Research market trends, competitor products, emerging ingredients, consumer preferences, and new product opportunities in the skincare and beauty industry.
* Coordinate product sampling, formulation trials, stability testing, compatibility testing, and product performance evaluations with relevant technical teams.
* Track product development milestones, sample approvals, revisions, and launch timelines.
* Coordinate with marketing, packaging, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure product readiness before launch.
* Maintain comprehensive records of product specifications, approved samples, costing sheets, development status, and supplier documentation.
* **2. Procurement & Vendor Management**
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers and vendors for skincare ingredients, raw materials, packaging materials, labels, cartons, and other product components.
* Source suitable third-party manufacturers and contract manufacturing partners based on product requirements, quality standards, production capabilities, and commercial terms.
* Obtain and compare quotations, negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities (MOQs), lead times, and delivery schedules.
* Raise purchase orders and coordinate with vendors to ensure timely delivery of materials as per approved requirements.
* Develop and maintain a reliable vendor database, including supplier credentials, pricing, lead times, and performance records.
* Build strong vendor relationships to ensure consistent supply, competitive pricing, and timely resolution of procurement issues.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising product quality, safety, or brand standards.
* **3. Costing & Budget Management**
* Prepare product costing sheets covering raw materials, packaging, manufacturing, testing, and other applicable development costs.
* Evaluate vendor quotations and support cost negotiations to achieve target product costs and margins.
* Track actual costs against approved budgets and highlight significant cost variations.
* Support management in evaluating product feasibility based on target pricing, minimum order quantities, and expected commercial viability.
* Maintain updated records of product costs, supplier pricing, and procurement commitments.
* **4. Quality & Regulatory Coordination**
* Coordinate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure that ingredients, packaging materials, formulations, and finished products meet applicable quality and compliance requirements.
* Obtain and maintain relevant supplier documentation, including specifications, Certificates of Analysis (CoAs), Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and other applicable technical documents.
* Ensure that required product testing, stability assessments, packaging compatibility checks, and approvals are completed before commercial production, in coordination with the responsible technical teams.
* Support documentation and compliance requirements applicable to cosmetics and personal care products in India.
* Coordinate the resolution of quality issues, rejected samples, material discrepancies, and supplier non-conformities.
* **5. Production Planning & Coordination**
* Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers to align procurement schedules with product development and launch timelines.
* Monitor material availability, production schedules, order status, and delivery commitments.
* Follow up on pending samples, purchase orders, packaging approvals, and manufacturing requirements to avoid delays.
* Identify potential supply chain risks and escalate issues affecting product development, cost, quality, or launch dates.
* Work closely with inventory and operations teams to support material planning and avoid excess inventory or stock shortages.
* **6. Documentation & Reporting**
* Maintain an NPD tracker covering product concepts, sampling stages, approvals, costs, testing status, and expected launch dates.
* Maintain procurement trackers for purchase orders, vendor quotations, delivery schedules, and outstanding materials.
* Prepare regular reports on product development progress, procurement savings, vendor performance, and pending activities.
* Ensure proper documentation of product development decisions, supplier agreements, commercial terms, and approvals.
* **Requirements**
* 3–6 years of experience in new product development, procurement, sourcing, or product operations, preferably within skincare, cosmetics, beauty, personal care, or FMCG.
* Experience coordinating with third-party manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, and packaging vendors.
* Understanding of skincare product development, including formulations, ingredients, packaging components, sampling, and testing processes.
* Working knowledge of procurement processes, vendor negotiations, purchase orders, costing, and supplier management.
* Ability to evaluate quotations, compare commercial terms, and identify cost optimisation opportunities.
* Strong coordination and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple product development projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and documentation or procurement tracking tools.
* Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage deadlines across multiple stakeholders.
* **Good to Have**
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and private-label skincare or cosmetic brands.
* Familiarity with cosmetic ingredients, INCI nomenclature, formulation briefs, and packaging compatibility.
* Understanding of cosmetic quality documentation, stability testing, and Indian cosmetics regulatory requirements.
* Experience with ERP, inventory management, or procurement management systems.
* Exposure to product launches across e-commerce, D2C, retail, or modern trade channels.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Timely completion of NPD milestones and product launches.
* Reduction in product development lead times and sample approval cycles.
* Achievement of target product costs and measurable procurement savings.
* Timely sourcing and delivery of raw materials and packaging components.
* Vendor performance in terms of quality, pricing, responsiveness, and delivery adherence.
* Accuracy and completeness of product development and procurement documentation.
* Compliance with approved quality standards and completion of required testing and approvals before launch.
* **What Success Looks Like in the First 6–12 Months**
* Establish a structured NPD pipeline with clear timelines, responsibilities, and approval stages.
* Build a dependable vendor network for ingredients, packaging, and contract manufacturing.
* Improve development turnaround time and procurement efficiency.
* Deliver new products within approved cost, quality, and launch timelines.
* Create a well-maintained database of product specifications, supplier quotations, costing sheets, and development records.

**The Team**
Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.

Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.

* Drive operating model and process design initiatives, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technology enablement.
* Apply a strong understanding of technology architecture, platforms, and vendor landscapes to advise clients on modernization and transformation opportunities.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders—particularly banks, card networks, fintechs, merchant payment processors, and capital markets firms—to shape actionable strategies and implementation roadmaps
* Bring a hands-on consulting approach, balancing rigorous analysis with pragmatic execution, to solve complex client challenges
* Proactively own and structure client deliverables, including managing Consultants and Analysts in working towards a common goal

**Enterprise and Growth Strategy – FSI – B&CM**
**Strategy-specific Experience:**

**Enterprise and Growth Strategy (Financial Services Industry) Experience:**

* Hands-on experience of working in Corporate Strategy or consulting firm catering to leading FSI companies in one or more of the following domains – Consumer Banking, Retail Banking, Transaction Banking, Digital Lending, Payments (Merchant Payments Strategy, Payment Method Issuance – Operations and Launch Strategy etc. (minimum 3 years of post-MBA experience for Senior Consultant level)
* Enterprise and Growth Strategy consulting experience - Corporate Strategy, Go-to-market (GTM) Strategy, Business Unit Growth Strategy, Roadmap Development, Business Model, Capability Assessment, Efficiency Plays, Cost Take-out, Market Research / Assessment, Business Planning, Business & Digital Transformation, Vendor Assessment, Operating Model Assessment, etc.) within Financial Services Industry
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends within the Financial Services industry, with interest and knowledge about the current trends in Banking and Payments
* Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve them
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues with senior-level clients including C-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders
* Exposure around building dynamic Excel models and macros for market sizing, forecasting, and automation of repetitive analysis and reporting tasks
* Ability to craft structured generative research prompts and use tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or MS Copilot in Excel/PowerPoint) to streamline research, create slides, synthesize interviews, or simulate models
* Experience in developing and deploying LLM tools to accelerate research, generate summaries, and support slide creation

**Core Consulting Skills**

* Clear and concise communication - Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops / trainings and present recommendations; strong verbal and written skills are critical
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking – Comfortable with managing large data sets, ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary), synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data through configurable dashboards; familiarity with Python, and Excel Macro scripting is nice to have
* Logical structuring - Structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused – Support team in development of deliverables, manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Ownership – Take ownership, manage and co-ordinate activities and tasks assigned and drive to completion
* Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization

**#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Required Qualifications**
**For Sr. Consultant:**

* MBA or MS from a premier (Tier-1) school in India or abroad
* 4+ years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA)
* Experience in consulting, or corporate strategy environment strongly preferred
* 2+ years of industry experience with B&CM focus (preferably US clients)

**About the Role:**
We are looking for an experienced
**Platform and Digital Enablement Lead**
to lead the digital enablement of our Governance, Risk and Control (GRC) landscape.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on delivery role responsible for bringing together GRC platforms, digital workflows, AI and automation, data quality, self-service capabilities and user adoption. The role will own the integrated product roadmap and lead the Platform, Digital Enablement and Data Quality team, while personally driving complex cross-product initiatives.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in translating GRC standards and strategy into scalable, governed and user-focused digital solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and drive the integrated roadmap and prioritized portfolio across GRC platforms, workflows, AI, continuous controls monitoring, digital guidance, learning, adoption and data quality.
* Translate GRC strategy and approved framework requirements into clear capabilities, sequenced releases, dependencies, resource requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Lead and develop Platform Managers, Digital Enablement Managers and the Data Quality Manager, establishing clear product ownership and delivery standards.
* Personally lead complex initiatives that bring together platform, data, AI, workflow, controls and adoption requirements.
* Act as the senior functional product authority for the GRC digital landscape, ensuring standardization, architecture alignment, auditability and a strong end-to-end user experience.
* Govern portfolio intake, business cases, prioritization, design decisions, acceptance criteria, testing, release readiness, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with engineering teams on build capacity, technical dependencies, operational support, incident resolution and sustainable product ownership.
* Establish robust data-quality rules, reconciliations, ownership and exception processes to support trusted workflows, analytics and management reporting.
* Establish responsible AI and automation guardrails, including appropriate human oversight, traceability, explainability and quality controls.

**Core Comptencies:**

* Proven leadership experience managing enterprise GRC platforms, preferably SAP GRC solutions, and digital product portfolios.
* Deep expertise in GRC processes, controls, workflow design, and governance architecture.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI, automation, and continuous controls monitoring capabilities at scale.
* Strong knowledge of SAP GRC Process Control, including data governance, data quality, and management reporting.
* Ability to lead and develop teams while personally driving complex cross-functional transformation and adoption initiatives.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience, with significant experience across GRC, digital platforms, technology-enabled transformation, product management, risk, controls or related areas.
* Strong experience in digital product and portfolio leadership, including roadmap prioritization and value management.
* Good understanding of GRC platforms, workflow architecture and digitally enabled risk and compliance processes.
* Experience working with AI and automation, with an understanding of responsible governance, human oversight, traceability and quality controls.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality and associated controls.
* Experience driving digital adoption, self-service capabilities and service design.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across business and technology teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong people leadership capabilities, combined with the ability and willingness to remain hands-on in the delivery of complex initiatives.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships:**
The role will work closely with:
  
  

* Head of GRC Standards, Platform and Reporting
* Platform Managers
* Digital Enablement Managers
* Data Quality Manager
* Governance & Standard and Data & Reporting roles
* Product, Platform and Engineering teams
* GPLs, FPOs and first-line users
* PEX, A&I and external auditors

**Measures of Success:**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

* Delivery of portfolio milestones
* Requirement-to-release cycle time
* Release quality and critical defects
* Platform availability and incident trends
* Self-service and active adoption
* Data-quality rule pass rates
* Reduction in manual effort
* User confidence and support demand

You will be accountable for maintaining an integrated and prioritized roadmap across platform, AI, self-service, adoption and data quality; ensuring the functional quality, usability, auditability and adoption of GRC digital products; maintaining reliable data controls; and ensuring responsible governance of AI and automation with appropriate human oversight

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**

* Define Insurance Policies & Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes & Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance & Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance-related quality questions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.
* Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance plans, carriers, provider networks.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics and data to drive strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to influence stakeholders across functions.
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker or other analytical tools is a must.
* Familiarity and proven usage of AI-driven tools and workflow automation is a must.

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. title: Senior Director, Data Platform Services
description:

* Build and scale an agile, high-performing engineering organization: strong technical bar, high accountability, and a culture where teams take genuine ownership of what they ship.
* Recruit, develop, and retain strong engineering managers and engineers; build a durable leadership bench across all sites.
* Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and run rigorous, fair performance and career development processes for the org.

* Champion developer experience across the organization: streamlined onboarding, clear documentation, and low-friction tooling, so engineers at every site can ramp quickly and stay productive.

End-to-End Execution & Delivery Ownership
  
  

* Own execution end to end for the S3, POSIX, and NFS offerings, from planning and prioritization through delivery, quality, and production readiness.
* Define and continuously improve the engineering processes, release practices, and quality gates that let distributed teams ship enterprise-grade software predictably.

* Bring a strong technical grounding in data platforms and storage systems to engage credibly in architecture, design, and technical trade-off discussions.

* Embed quality as a first-class engineering discipline: testing, observability, and reliability practices built into the development lifecycle rather than bolted on at the end.

Cross-Timezone & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Proven ownership of end-to-end execution for complex software offerings, from planning through production delivery and support.

* Track record of working effectively across time zones and geographies, with proven success partnering closely with US-based executive stakeholders.

title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)
description:
**Job Title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

* L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible

title: Head of Product and Engineering - Director
description:
**Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering**
**Location:**
Pune (Hybrid)
  
  
**Line of Business:**
Compliance Technology / Enterprise Technology
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?
  
  
At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the
**Head of Product and Engineering**
, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.
  
  
In this dual-hatted role, you will:
  
  
**Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms:**
Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.
  
  
**Serve as the India Site Lead:**
Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
* Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
* Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
* AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
* Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
* Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
* Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
* Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
* Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
* Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.
* India Site Leadership
* Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
* Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
* Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

**Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture**
We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:
  
  

* Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
* Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
* Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
* AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
* Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
* Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
* Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
* Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
* Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Why Join Citi?**

* Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
* True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.
* Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery.

**And many more reasons…**

title: Senior Product Manager - Web Merchandising
description:
**Job Description**
**About Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**
Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center is the technology hub for Williams-Sonoma, Inc., supporting global digital commerce, supply chain, enterprise platforms, and customer experiences across our portfolio of brands. The India Technology Center partners closely with global business and engineering teams to build scalable, resilient, and innovative platforms that serve millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Merchandising Systems Product Management team is responsible for the technology platforms and tools that support the end-to-end product lifecycle across Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands, from initial item intake and item setup through product enrichment, merchandising, and publication across all channels.
  
  
Our ecosystem includes Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Information Management (PIM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), Web Assortment Management (WAM), and downstream eCommerce systems. Together, these capabilities enable our brands to manage product information, content, and assets efficiently at scale for our customers.
  
  
By improving these technology solutions, we help WSI bring new product assortments to market faster, improve product and content quality, reduce manual effort, and respond effectively to evolving product, market, and customer needs.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Merchandising Systems team at our India Technology Center in Pune.
  
  
Web merchandising is at the heart of WSI's eCommerce business, shaping how millions of products are brought to life across our brands and digital experiences. Your initial focus will be Web Assortment Management (WAM), a major multi-year transformation replacing a legacy platform that has supported the business for more than 16 years. WAM will become the core platform for organizing, enriching, validating, reviewing, and publishing online assortments across WSI's eCommerce sites.
  
  
In this hands-on role, you will translate product strategy into well-defined capabilities and drive them through delivery and brand adoption. You will work closely with the Engineering team in Pune and partner with US-based Product, business, UX, Architecture, and Technology teams. A US-based Lead Product Manager will set overall WAM direction and priorities; within that direction, you will define requirements, make product decisions, manage dependencies, and drive assigned capabilities from concept through rollout.
  
  
A significant part of the role is helping brand users successfully adopt new WAM capabilities and processes. You will study current workflows, identify improvement opportunities, demonstrate new functionality, develop and deliver training, support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and guide users through the transition from legacy tools and processes.
  
  
WAM will be the primary focus as the platform is delivered, launched, and scaled. Over time, the role may expand to other enterprise merchandising and content platforms, including Digital Asset Management and Site Content Management.
  
  
**You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will...**

* Own product execution for assigned WAM capabilities and workstreams, translating product strategy and priorities into detailed requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
* Partner closely with the Pune Engineering team throughout the product development lifecycle, providing product context, resolving requirements questions, making trade-offs, and ensuring delivered solutions achieve intended business outcomes.
* Develop deep expertise in WAM, online assortment management, and the workflows used by brand teams to manage product assortment and content at scale.
* Partner with brand users and US-based Product and business stakeholders to understand current processes, pain points, workarounds, and requirements, and translate them into scalable solutions across WSI brands.
* Partner with UX to translate complex business workflows into intuitive experiences for business users.
* Work with Engineering and Architecture on platform capabilities, data models, integrations, validation and publishing workflows, and dependencies across PIM, DAM, image services, and eCommerce systems.
* Translate abstract technical concepts and complex system behavior into clear product requirements, practical workflows, and solutions that business users can understand.
* Identify risks, requirements gaps, edge cases, and cross-system dependencies early, and maintain a clear, actionable backlog that provides Engineering with the context needed for delivery.
* Lead or support UAT, including scenario definition, business-user coordination, issue triage, and translation of findings into product improvements.
* Drive business readiness and adoption through stakeholder engagement, workflow documentation, product demonstrations, training and enablement, rollout support, and ongoing feedback.
* Measure product effectiveness using qualitative and quantitative feedback, including adoption, workflow efficiency, time to market, data quality, platform performance, and business-user satisfaction.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, improve data quality, accelerate new assortment introduction, and help the business respond more quickly to product and market updates.
* Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, scope decisions, and trade-offs clearly across US and India Product, Engineering, and business teams.

**Why you will love working at Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**

* We're a successful, fast-growing company with an entrepreneurial vibe.
* A technologically and data-driven business.
* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits.
* We're at the forefront of tech and retail, redefining technology for the next generation.
* We're passionate about our internal and external clients and live and breathe the client experience.
* We get to be creative on a daily basis.
* A smart, experienced leadership team that wants to do it right and is open to new ideas.
* We believe in autonomy and reward taking initiative.

**We're Excited About You Because...**

* You have 5+ years of Product Management, Technical Product Management, or senior business systems experience delivering technology solutions.
* You have experience delivering complex enterprise platforms, internal business tools, or multi-system programs with significant workflow and integration complexity, in close partnership with Engineering.
* You can translate business problems and workflows into detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and scalable technology solutions.
* You can balance business workflow and change-management responsibilities with abstract technical concepts, complex platform architecture, attribution and data models, integrations, and system behavior.
* You have experience working with business operations users and driving change for enterprise tools or processes through stakeholder engagement, demonstrations, training, UAT, rollout support, and adoption.
* You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can identify edge cases, evaluate trade-offs, and make decisions in ambiguous situations.
* You communicate clearly and operate effectively across geographically distributed Product, Engineering, business, and leadership teams.
* You hold a bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or have equivalent professional experience.
* You can work from our India Technology Center in Pune according to WSI's onsite and hybrid working requirements.

**Technical Competencies Required**

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage meaningfully with engineers and architects on integrations, data models, system workflows, platform architecture, and technical trade-offs.
* Ability to create clear product artifacts, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, prioritized backlogs, and delivery plans.
* Understanding of enterprise platform integrations and upstream and downstream dependencies across product information, digital asset, content, image, and eCommerce systems.
* Experience defining UAT scenarios, coordinating business validation, triaging issues, and converting findings into actionable product improvements.
* Ability to define and track product success measures such as adoption, workflow efficiency, time to market, data quality, platform performance, and user satisfaction.

**Preferred Experience**

* Knowledge of retail, eCommerce, merchandising, product information, content management, or digital asset management.
* Experience with platforms such as PLM, PIM, DAM, CMS/WCM, WAM, vendor portals, or merchandising systems.
* Experience supporting enterprise platform modernization, legacy-system replacement, or multi-year transformation programs.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

* Our people-first and performance-driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career, and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership environment that empowers associates to make real impact.
* Build and shape large-scale digital commerce and merchandising platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale technology challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

title: Manager / Sr Manager – Engine Application, Technical Solutions & BD
description:
**Job Description:**

Manager / Senior Manager – Engine Application, Technical Solutions & Business Development

Location: Pune | Reporting To: Business Head / Head – Engine Business

SUMMARY

To lead the Engine Application business by understanding customer equipment requirements, recommending suitable engine solutions, and providing technical support throughout the sales, integration, and commissioning lifecycle. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end business management, including customer acquisition, account management, revenue generation, profitability, collections, and customer service while acting as the technical expert for engine application engineering and business growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Application Engineering & Engine Selection**

Study customer machine/equipment specifications and operating conditions.

Recommend suitable diesel, gas, or alternate fuel engines based on power, torque, duty cycle, emissions, and performance requirements.

Perform engine sizing, load analysis, and application feasibility assessments.

Ensure proper engine-machine compatibility and integration.

**Customer Engagement & Technical Consulting**

Interact with OEMs, machine manufacturers, industrial customers, consultants, and EPC contractors.

Understand customer requirements and provide technically optimized solutions.

Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations, and solution discussions.

Support customers during design, installation, testing, commissioning, and after-sales support stages.

**Business Development & Sales Management**

Drive revenue growth from engine application and technical solutions business.

Identify, develop, and onboard new customers, OEMs, and business partners.

Generate enquiries and convert opportunities into confirmed orders.

Develop and manage key customer relationships to ensure long-term business growth.

Support preparation of techno-commercial proposals, bids, and business presentations.

Achieve annual sales, revenue, and profitability targets.

**P&L Ownership & Commercial Management**

Manage the Profit & Loss (P&L) for the assigned business segment.

Monitor revenue, margins, profitability, and business performance.

Ensure effective pricing, commercial negotiations, and contract management.

Drive cost optimization initiatives while maintaining customer satisfaction.

**Customer Service & Account Management**

Own end-to-end customer lifecycle management from enquiry to payment realization.

Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat business.

Address customer concerns and coordinate internal teams for timely resolution.

Develop customer engagement plans and strengthen strategic account relationships.

**Debtors, Collections & Payment Recovery**

Monitor customer outstanding balances and ageing reports.

Ensure timely collection of payments and recovery of overdue receivables.

Coordinate with finance and customers to resolve payment-related issues.

Maintain healthy debtor levels and optimize working capital.

**OEM & Supplier Coordination**

Liaise with engine manufacturers and technology partners for product selection and customization.

Coordinate with suppliers and engineering teams for application-specific requirements.

Support development of new products and customized solutions.

**Project Execution & Field Support**

Support installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and performance validation activities.

Conduct site visits and application audits.

Resolve application-related issues and provide corrective recommendations.

**Product & Market Development**

Track market trends, customer requirements, and competitor offerings.

Identify opportunities for introducing new engine technologies and solutions.

Support product positioning and market expansion initiatives.

**Documentation & Compliance**

Prepare technical specifications, application notes, and customer documentation.

Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards and emission norms.

Maintain application records, customer database, and technical reports.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

Revenue and profitability achieved from Engine Application Business

P&L performance against budget

New customer acquisition and market development

Proposal-to-order conversion ratio

Customer retention and satisfaction levels

Debtor ageing and collection efficiency

Timely payment recovery and working capital management

Number of successful engine application projects executed

Timely resolution of customer and technical issues

Reduction in field failures and application-related complaints

You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend.Responsibilities AI Architecture & Custom IntegrationDesign, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components.Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects.Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e.g., CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization. Revenue Ecosystem OptimizationPartner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high-cost, low-utility third-party vendors.Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations.Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting. Cross-Functional EfficiencyCollaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output.Qualifications5+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads-to-Revenue" funnel and "Best-in-Class" SaaS ecosystems.Ability to write and maintain production integrations — Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent — connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no-code tools. Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack — specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etcProven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD," you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel. Experience with AI agent orchestration — managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce). Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents — treating agent training as a discipline, not a one-time setup. Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it — and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all.Additional InformationYour health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill setAbout QAD And QAD RedzoneQAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. title: Senior Technology Leader
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Technology Leader– Asset Servicing Data & Digital**
**Role Summary**
The Senior Technology Leader– Asset Servicing Data & Digital Technology is a senior technology hands-on leader role responsible for
**driving the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise data and digital platforms**
. This position combines
**hands-on technical leadership**
with strategic oversight of large-scale programs to enable scalable, secure, and client-centric solutions.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise across
**full-stack engineering, modern data platforms, and cloud-native architectures**
, along with the ability to
**lead high-performing teams and deliver complex, high-value initiatives**
aligned to business priorities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technology Strategy & Architecture
* Lead architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise digital and data platforms.
* Define and drive adoption of modern engineering patterns, including:

+ Event-driven architecture and Pub/Sub models
+ Domain-driven design (DDD)
+ Microservices and containerization
+ Cloud-native architecture (Azure preferred)
+ Data engineering pipeline

* Ensure delivery of secure, scalable, and resilient systems aligned with enterprise standards.
* Application Development & Platform Ownership
* Provide technical leadership across Portals, Datamart, and Datashare platforms, ensuring consistent architecture and integration.
* Oversee full-stack development practices, including:

+ Frontend (React and modern UX frameworks)
+ Backend (Java, Spring, APIs, Python, Snowflake)
+ C++ is nice to have

* Drive engineering excellence across the full SDLC, ensuring high-quality, maintainable codebases.
* Strategic Program Leadership
* Lead delivery of key business initiatives, including enterprise integration of Fenergo across Asset Servicing platforms.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technology solutions and roadmaps.
* Manage execution across multiple projects, ensuring alignment to timelines, quality, and client expectations.
* Data Engineering & Platform Enablement
* Lead development of enterprise data platforms, including Data Hubs, Data Marts, and analytics solutions.
* Design and implement data engineering solutions that leverage Snowflake and cloud-based technologies.
* Oversee data modelling, governance, and data quality practices to support enterprise analytics and regulatory requirements.
* People Leadership & Talent Development
* Build, lead, and mentor high-performing engineering teams, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Identify and develop top talent, creating an environment that motivates, challenges, and retains employees.
* Promote best practices in technology, collaboration, and agile delivery. 6. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
* Collaborate with global business and technology teams to ensure alignment on strategy, architecture, and delivery.
* Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders to provide status, risks, and solution direction.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, governance standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Delivery Excellence & Commercial Focus
* Drive execution with a results-oriented and commercially aware mindset.
* Apply critical thinking and problem-solving to address complex challenges and drive outcomes.
* Ensure efficient prioritization, planning, and delivery across competing initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong experience in full-stack software engineering:

+ React / modern UX frameworks
+ Java, Spring Boot, APIs, Python, Snowflake, SQL

* Advanced proficiency in:

+ Event-driven architecture and distributed systems
+ Domain-driven design (DDD)
+ Microservices architecture
+ Containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
+ Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
+ Python and Snowflake based applications

* Strong knowledge of:

+ Data modelling (relational, dimensional etc)
+ Data engineering and analytics platforms (Snowflake, Databricks)
+ Enterprise security and integration patterns

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Proven track record of leading large-scale, complex technology programs.
* Experience managing multiple teams and concurrent projects in a global environment.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and delivery frameworks

**Domain Knowledge**

* Experience in Asset Servicing, Asset Management, or Financial Services preferred.
* Familiarity with Northern Trust systems, platforms, and design patterns is desirable.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong critical thinking and analytical skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to attract, retain, and develop top talent

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Typically 15+ years of overall experience, including leadership of mid-to-large engineering teams

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI/ML or advanced analytics
* Knowledge of regulatory and data governance frameworks in financial services
* Exposure to modern data management tools and ETL frameworks

**Working Conditions**

* High collaboration role requiring interaction across global teams
* Fast-paced environment with multiple concurrent initiatives

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service
  
  
Overview and Context
  
  
As part of the Network Products business unit, the Next Generation Network Team is at the heart of Mastercard’s transformation, driving innovation and modernization to ensure the network remains resilient, flexible, and competitive in a rapidly evolving payments landscape.
  
  
This team is responsible for building Mastercard’s next-generation unified switch and access capabilities, designed to handle all payment and related data flows across transaction types and payment schemes.
  
  
Within Next Gen Network, the Network Expansion team is driving Product Development for a new product named “Switching as a Service” (SwaaS), which opens a new business model in which Mastercard leverages its next-generation platform to switch domestic payment schemes according to their rules, interchange, and settlement, hosted and operated by Mastercard.
  
  
Network Products has signed its first large and strategic SwaaS contract and needs to grow its Product Development team to manage its design, build, and run activities.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
This VP role will lead a team having Product Development accountability for the Core Switching and Data-related services of the SwaaS. The role will ensure delivery of this scope according to the contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions.
  
  
Given the large scope and complexity of SwaaS, this individual will partner closely with a large network of actors, such as: other SwaaS Product Development team members managing other parts of the SwaaS, Avanti project management structure, representative from Product and Engineering of each contributing program, Regional lead driving the on-soil relationship with the SwaaS customer and providing product management and GTM role, Customer delivery, Global Customer Care, Security, Network, etc.
  
  
The individual will also have direct relationship with representatives from the SwaaS customer team to ensure full alignment between their expectations and our solutioning while protecting Mastercard’s interest and goals. This SwaaS project spread across multiple time zones.
  
  
The role demands a strong product mindset, drive, structure, organization, technical acumen across the scope, and will require a high degree of collaboration across technical, customer-facing, and other stakeholder teams to bring the first SwaaS implementation to home.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the Product Development team in charge of the Core Switching and Data-related capabilities of the SwaaS product from intake through elaboration, execution, build, and run.
* Within the SwaaS governance, provide regular & detailed reporting, stay ahead in risk management, and ensure that the resources allocated to SwaaS execution are rightly used in partnership with PMO’s and Finance.
* Own delivery of the allocated scope and coordinate with Product Management and Engineering teams to meet contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions.
* Ensure the integrity and consistency of SwaaS delivery across vision, capabilities, scalability, performance, speed-to-market, readiness for growth, and reusability.
* Build and maintain detailed functional and technical understanding of the delivered platform, including requirements, use cases, architecture, dependencies, interfaces, data flows, runtime operations, support strategies, and maintenance needs.
* Drive stakeholder alignment across the SwaaS ecosystem, including Product, Engineering, Franchise, Global Customer Delivery, Privacy, and other contributing teams.
* Lead by example with a hands-on approach, demonstrate product management excellence, and share best practices.
* Apply logic, reasoning, and sound decision-making to develop solutions with all teams. Clarify concepts and build a shared understanding of what will ultimately be delivered.
* Define capabilities that enhance the Next Gen platform, respect the platform strategy and principles, and ensure platform integrity.
* Support other SwaaS Product team members to ensure collective success. Replicate knowledge, share workload across initiatives, provide mutual backup, and help the team scale, learn, and expand its scope.
* Establish product development discipline in the team, including clear methods, structure, content standards, reliable execution, and high-quality on-time contributions.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performance team while fostering a culture of execution, accountability, and innovation.
* Identify opportunities for leveraging AI to improve speed, efficiency and quality.

**All About You**

* Fluent in English
* 10+ years of product development or product management experience in complex, geographically distributed environments
* Experience managing and developing teams. People leader.
* Executive-level stakeholder management and influence in a matrixed organization
* Expected to bring a strong execution mindset, sound judgment, and practical problem-solving skills
* Strong technical foundation required to understand complex platform capabilities, dependencies, and delivery risks
* Prior experience in payments and/or fintech is required; experience with card processing systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, is preferred
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment across product and engineering teams, including dependency management
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities
* Strong problem solver who can navigate complexity, unblock teams, and identify alternative paths to deliver the outcomes
* Strong experience with complex technical products and customer integration planning is a plus
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and workstream management skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate problem statements, frame options and trade-off, and engage internal and external stakeholders clearly.
* Customer-facing experience is preferred
* Ability to work with ambiguity and manage complex projects in fast-paced environments
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and with minimal day-to-day supervision
* Ability to build effective relationships with senior leaders, internal teams, and external clients
* Flexibility to work with multiple time zones

Location: Pune only
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
