title: Product Manager, AI
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**
As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.
  
  
You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Turn business goals into clear software requirements.
* Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.
* Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.
* Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.
* Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.
* Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.
* Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.
* Rank feature requests from the development teams.
* Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.
* Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.
* Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.
* Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

**What You'll Bring**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.
* Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.
* Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.
* Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.
* Structured approach and experience with agile methods.
* History of working with development teams to get results.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.
* Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.
* Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Why Work for Us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Sr. Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Title: Data Product Lead/ Manager**
**What You Will Do**
The future is being built today, and Johnson Controls is making that future more productive, secure, and sustainable. We are harnessing the power of cloud, data analytics, the Internet of Things, and user design thinking to deliver on the promise of intelligent buildings and smart cities that connect communities in ways that make people’s lives – and the world – better & safer.
  
  
Data Team is a diverse team of technology enthusiast enabling our global business. Data Product Manager is an integral part of the Data team. This role will be based out of India, reporting into Senior Data Product Manager. He/she will be responsible for defining the delivery and support for applications utilizing Snowflake, Azure and related data tools. As a Data Product Manager, you are responsible for managing Data Product Delivery and Support team. This role requires strong relationships with business stakeholders and key staff members to clearly understand the overall business objectives and functional process requirements. This role is responsible for translating the business requirements into an functional data product. This position must be able to work across organizational boundaries to manage the successful execution of projects and initiatives, ensuring on schedule, on-quality, and on-budget project performance. This role will provide oversight and direction to the data product delivery staff aligned to each project. + Big Data Analytics, Cloud Data platforms

title: Senior Specialist, Product Development
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, Product Development
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Prepaid Management Services global digital presence with over 55+ websites and 10+ mobile application. We are looking for senior specialist to be responsible for maintaining the current portfolio of customer facing channels - Mobile apps, My Account, Commercial platforms. The role holder will be responsible for managing the lifecycle of product features, enhancements and work collaboratively with the relevant regional product, account management, marketing, engineering, Bizops teams, Compliance and Legal to oversee the successful delivery of the changes as well as the launch of new digital platforms and capabilities.
  
  
**The Role**

* Managing the growth of Mastercard’s Prepaid Management Services (MPMS) websites: Including product capabilities, Web, CMS and mobile app updates and constant innovation to drive business success online.
* Attending scrum ceremonies and working closely with internal web and mobile development teams, to improve the user experience and always put the customer first.
* Delivering digital platforms for MPMS and clients, including the launch of new marketing, servicing sites and mobile application.
* Implement digital best practice, improve existing customer experience and drive financial growth with a focus on platform consolidation.
* Use data driven insights to reduce customer friction across our portfolio of websites and mobile apps.
* Provide regular analytical reporting and recommendations based on data.
* Partnering with and supporting regional team (Marketing, Product and Sales in particular) to advise on best practice digital execution and instigate change for the better.

**About You**

* The role requires someone with a strong all-round approach to digital; ranging from content management, launching of new features/functionality in production and a strong desire to innovate and learn from the ecommerce industry.
* Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature-level customer issues.
* A team player that wishes to support an innovative and fun global team by aligning to strategy, understanding the goals of the team and always working towards success.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to work with and influence people across the organisation
* Reviews product demo against acceptance criteria for the feature set
* Supports and participates in post-launch reviews and ensures feedback is reincorporated into the feature
* Enables self-service support and/or works to reduce overhead
* Owns and manages product documentation ensuring features and associated documentation are clear.
* Experience in the SAFe/Agile software development lifecycle methodology
* A background in financial services is desirable; knowledge/experience in actively managing websites or mobile apps is a must.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
  
  
The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea-to-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
  
  

* Lead end-to-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea-to-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

**Skills**

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
  
  
We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key Responsibilities:**

We are hiring a full-time Product Analyst to own modules of our internal Order-to-Cash platform, end to end, working directly with the Product Lead. The core of the role is building requirements: understanding the business process, identifying its gaps, and structuring it into a complete system module that accounts for every case, validation and dependency. You will also test what gets built and make sure the delivered solution matches what was defined.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Requirement building (core)

• Understand business workflows across Sales, Onboarding, Operations and Finance, and identify

process gaps and inefficiencies

• Structure each process into a system module with clear flows and flow charts

• Cover every scenario the module must handle (standard, exception and edge cases) before it

goes to development

• Define fields and data structures, validation rules, dependencies and conditions

• Own and maintain the functional specification for each assigned module

2. Testing and quality assurance

• Write and execute functional test cases for every release

• Run end-to-end workflow testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Log, prioritise and re-test bugs through the periodic bug-fix cycles

3. Development partner coordination

• Work with the external development team on assigned modules

• Track tasks, follow-ups and requirement clarifications

• Ensure the delivered solution matches the defined requirement

4. Data checks for owned modules

• Validate data for the modules you own, including post-go-live accuracy checks

• Work alongside the data management team where module data is involved

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-have**

• 1–3 years in a product, business analyst or functional/QA role on software or ERP projects

• Hands-on experience writing functional specs or BRDs and test cases

• Experience working with development teams through build, testing and release

• Strong analytical and logical thinking; able to structure problems into clear workflows

• Basic understanding of APIs and system design: data flow, validations, logic layers

• Attention to detail and execution focus

• Clear communication across business and tech teams

**Good-to-have**

• Exposure to ERP tools, especially Zoho Books

• Familiarity with Order-to-Cash or billing processes

• Basic SQL

• Exposure to AI or automation use cases (document processing, workflow automation)

Tools you will use

• HTML (basic UI understanding)

• AI tools for productivity and documentation

• Excel and basic analytics tools

**Culture Fit:**
Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Head of Research and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
  Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.

description:

Senior Vice President, POM Product Owner

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

title: Head of Product Business Unit
description:
**About Us**
**HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT**
Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people
  
  
**About Anchanto**
Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.
  
  
This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.
  
  
**WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS**

* Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging.
* Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them.
* Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it.
* The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build.
* Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities.
* Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing.

**COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT**
This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.
  
  
**How You Manage Your People**

* Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining.
* Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters.
* You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it.
* Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation.
* The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review.
* You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep.

**OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS**
An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.
  
  
**Who Decides What**

* Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date
  
  

* Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing
  
  

* Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO
  
  

* Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO
  
  
**How You Are Measured**
You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.
  
  

* Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live
  
  

* Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and delivery cost
  
  

* Reliability and customer satisfaction

What we look at: Availability, incidents and time to resolve, escaped defects, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT, and whether the unit found the problem before the customer did
  
  

* Planned versus actual

What we look at: Execution against the quarterly plan and the annual plan: objectives met, committed deliveries on date, say to do ratio, and variances explained in writing
  
  

* Market position

What we look at: Where the product stands against the Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant and IDC MarketScape criteria for its category, gaps closed each quarter, and analyst recognition over time
  
  

* AI leverage and AI first approach

What we look at: Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, cost and cycle time per delivered item falling every quarter, new work designed AI first
  
  

* Team EPS and health

What we look at: Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room
  
  
**PLANNING AND CADENCE**
You write the multi year product plan, the annual plan each October as a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios, and, four weeks before each quarter, a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly review on the two or three CEO goals for your unit.
  
  
**Skills And Prior Experience**
Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted.
  
  

* At least fifteen years of industry experience, with at least five of them running a product, product line, business unit or operation with accountability for its results.
* Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify.
* Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school.
* Domain. Commerce, logistics, supply chain or marketplace software, or the operations they serve, with enterprise customers.
* Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome. Has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Comfortable making AI assisted, specs driven engineering the default way of working.

Career paths we are open to. The role needs product, technology and business skills together; nobody arrives with all three at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each.
  
  

* Technology leader with product skills. Director of Engineering, CTO, CIO or equivalent, with deep experience in building, releasing and commercializing software systems, who has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs, not only delivered what product handed over.
* Product management leader with technology depth. Head of Product Management or commercial product management in B2B SaaS, with technology skills to a good extent: has led or closely directed engineering teams, can hold an architecture review, and has shipped and commercialized what they defined.
* Operations practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer or brand. Has run e-commerce, fulfilment or supply chain operations as a business at scale, with deep domain knowledge of how the work is actually done, and has specified, bought or built the systems behind it well enough to direct a product team.
* Consultant or transformation leader. Head of consulting, transformation or a consulting practice in commerce or supply chain, with deep consulting and domain expertise, who has delivered systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side.

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a Head of Engineering with a product manager reporting in, a delivery manager promoted up, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support to you and your family health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: VP - BA Client Journey Execution
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a VP – BA Client Journey Execution, where you will support the organisation in delivering its strategic objectives through the identification, definition, and delivery of business requirements and solutions that address complex business problems and opportunities.
  
  
In this role, you will work in close partnership with Product Owners and Technology teams to shape and deliver market‑leading digital products and client journeys, ensuring solutions are customer‑centric, scalable, and aligned to regulatory, operational, and strategic priorities. You will play a key role in driving the end‑to‑end onboarding and KYC journey, ensuring efficient execution, strong stakeholder alignment, and pace of delivery across complex change initiatives.
  
  
**Key Critical Skills Include**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst, ideally within financial services or regulated environments.
* Demonstrated experience working closely with Product Owners within Agile delivery models to implement market‑leading digital products and client journeys.
* Strong understanding of end‑to‑end client onboarding journeys, with KYC knowledge considered highly desirable.
* Formal change methodology qualifications, such as Agile Practitioner, Lean, and/or Six Sigma.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively across business, product, operations, compliance, and technology teams.
* A proven track record of delivering complex programmes at pace, managing ambiguity while maintaining delivery discipline and high-quality outcomes.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Business Consultant COE
description:
**Job Description**
The Business Consultant will be part of the Honeywell AutonomyX Center of Excellence (CoE) based in Pune, India, and will play an active role in developing and executing business consulting activities for Middle East, Turkey, and Central Asia (META) region opportunities, with flexibility to engage other regions depending on workload. This role will combine selective front-office ownership of qualified customer opportunities with back-office business development, analysis, proposal, and value-storyline execution in partnership with the Middle East business consulting team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Business development and selective opportunity leadership for META digital transformation programs for operating companies:
* Co-lead opportunity development for Honeywell AutonomyX and related transformation programs across META, working closely with the Middle East business consulting lead and regional sales teams, including

+ Research customer operating models, business priorities, performance improvement levers, and digital/autonomy transformation opportunities
+ Translate customer challenges into structured consulting problem statements linked to Honeywell and AutonomyX solutions
+ Own preparation of executive engagement materials, value hypotheses, customer narratives, and account-specific storylines for selected pursuits
+ Lead or actively participate in selected customer-facing discussions and workshops, including preparation, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up from Pune or on site when required
+ Own customer-ready material including value propositions, executive summaries, business cases, case studies, and sales enablement content for assigned opportunities
+ Lead preparation and follow-through for selected regional demonstrations, conferences, campaigns, and strategic pursuits

* Drive go-to-market planning inputs, account prioritization, white-space analysis, customer segmentation for Honeywell AutonomyX and Process Automation
* Consulting workshops, studies and execution ownership
* Lead or co-lead scoping of customer diagnostic exercises, workshops, value assessments, and consulting studies for selected META opportunities
* Develop consulting proposals, workshop agendas, data request lists, workplans, interview guides, and analysis frameworks with appropriate regional input
* Coordinate and drive inputs from technical, sales, and solution teams to produce structured consulting deliverables
* Own the development of diagnostic reports, gap analyses, business cases, value roadmaps, maturity assessments, and adoption plans for assigned workstreams
* Drive follow-up actions, maintain opportunity documentation, and lead handover from consulting discovery into sales execution where assigned
* CoE capability building and organizational enablement
* Build and continuously improve repeatable AutonomyX consulting assets, templates, value frameworks, and proposal content within the Pune CoE
* Lead selected internal enablement activities for value-based selling and consulting-led opportunity development across META
* Share best practices, case studies, and reusable methods with regional sales, consulting, and solution teams

**Qualifications**
**Skills and qualifications**

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school
* Prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, refining, petrochemicals, or other process industries preferred
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical engineering discipline preferred; Chemical Engineering is desirable, although other relevant engineering disciplines will be considered
* Preferred experience in running or contributing to operational transformation programs, performance improvement initiatives, digital transformation programs, or operating model improvement efforts
* Demonstrated ability to lead defined consulting workstreams, customer workshops, or opportunity development activities with senior stakeholder exposure
* Strong written communication and executive-presentation preparation skills, with ability to create clear customer-facing narratives and C-suite-ready materials
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to structure ambiguous business problems, identify customer value levers, and translate analysis into actionable recommendations
* Strong quantitative skills, including business case development, financial modelling, scenario planning, benchmarking, and value analysis
* Ability to work effectively from Pune with META stakeholders across time zones, balancing independent ownership, remote collaboration, and selected customer-facing engagement
* Ability to travel to Middle East selectively for high-value customer workshops, internal alignment sessions, and strategic pursuits as required

**Value proposition of role**

* Opportunity to help shape the AutonomyX CoE in Pune while taking ownership of selected strategic growth opportunities in the META region
* Blend of customer-facing consulting leadership and high-impact strategy, proposal, analysis, and execution ownership
* High visibility to regional business consulting, sales, and leadership teams through direct contribution to priority transformation pursuits
* Exposure to globally leading operating companies in the Middle East that are at the forefront of technology transformation, autonomy, and next-generation industrial operations
* Strong platform to develop expertise in autonomy, digital transformation, industrial operations, and value-based selling
* Role offers a broad problem-solving, business case, and opportunity-leadership remit across multiple industries and customer situations
* Selective travel intensity compared with pure front-office consulting, while retaining meaningful ownership of strategic customer engagements

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Deputy Manager - Launch
description:

**Location: Pune –**
Chakan, India
  
  
**Business Unit:**
Tenneco – Monroe Ride Solutions (MRS)
  
  
**Reports To:**
Plant Head / Program Management Director
  
  
**About Tenneco**
At Tenneco, we don’t follow industry standards; we set them, and we don’t settle for being best-in-class because we hustle to be better than best-in-class. Whether it’s our Core Values–radical candor, simplify, organizational velocity, tenacious execution and win–or our Get Stuff Done (GSD) mindset, we’re determined to become the most trusted partner and best manufacturer and distributor to the transportation industry.
  
  
How do we make it happen? Through the Tenneco Way. Fueled by our Core Values, a winning mindset and a relentless commitment to excellence, the Tenneco Way is how we win. It’s what keeps Team Tenneco bold, driven, and unapologetically focused on pushing past limits and redefining success. Here, you’ll work alongside a team of relentless problem-solvers who are committed to making a tangible impact. If you’re ready to break boundaries, deliver results, and enjoy the ride along the way, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Launch Manager – MRS Launch is responsible for end-to-end execution of new product/program launches for suspension systems (dampers, shock absorbers) at the Chakan facility. This role ensures on-time, on-cost, and on-quality launches while coordinating cross-functional teams including Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Customers (OEMs). The role is critical to ensure flawless program industrialization in a fast-paced automotive manufacturing environment.

* Program Launch Management
* Lead end-to-end program launch lifecycle from RFQ handover to SOP (Start of Production).
* Develop and manage detailed launch timelines, milestones, and risk mitigation plans.
* Ensure readiness for:
* Drive APQP deliverables and PPAP approvals with customers.
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Act as the single point of contact between:
* Ensure alignment across teams for seamless industrialization
* Manufacturing Readiness
* Ensure production line setup, process validation, and capacity readiness.
* Oversee trial builds, pilot runs, and ramp-up activities.
* Quality & Customer Compliance
* Ensure zero-defect launch mindset.
* Handle customer audits and launch reviews with OEMs (e.g., Tata Motors, Mahindra, VW, etc.)
* Cost & Budget Management
* Track and control program budgets, capex, and launch costs.
* Drive cost optimization without compromising quality or delivery.
* Ensure adherence to target costing and profitability goals.
* Risk Management
* Identify and mitigate launch risks (technical, supply chain, quality, timing).
* Maintain a robust risk register and escalation mechanism.
* Drive issue resolution with urgency and accountability.
* Supplier & Supply Chain Coordination
* Work with suppliers to ensure:
* Suport supplier PPAP and development activities.
* Continuous Improvement & Lessons Learned
* Capture lessons learned from launches and institutionalize best practices.
* Drive standardization across MRS launch processes.
* Support future platform scalability and repeat business wins.

**QUALIFICATIONS (Education/ Experience/ Key Competencies)**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical / automotive / production engineering
* MBA / PG in Operations or Program Management preferred
* 10-15+ years in automotive (Tier 1 preferred)
* Minimum 5+ years in program/launch management
* Experience in suspension systems/ Chassis components preferred
* Strong exposure to OEMs in Pune/ Chakan region

**Technical Skills**

* APQP / PPAP / FMEA / Control Plans
* New product introduction (NPI)
* Manufacturing process setup
* Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong stakeholder & customer management
* High accountability & execution focus
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making
* Ability to thrive in high-pressure launch environments

**Key Stakeholders**

* Internal: Plant Head, Engineering, Operations, Quality, SCM, Finance
* External: OEM customers, Tier-2 suppliers, tooling vendors

**Success Metrics**

* On-time SOP achievement
* PPAP approval timelines
* Launch cost vs budget adherence
* Zero launch defects / customer complaints
* Ramp-up efficiency & productivity

title: Global Business Process Analyst - Global Commercial

The Global Business Process Analyst will drive the optimization, harmonization, and digital enablement of commercial processes across Sulzer’s three divisions Flow, Services and Chemtech.
  
  
This role supports strategic initiatives within the Sulzer 2028 Strategy, enabling agile, data-driven decision-making and scalable process improvements across global sales and commercial operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead a newly established global function to optimise end‑to‑end commercial processes—spanning lead‑to‑order, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management—using LEAN and Six Sigma principles.
* Design and govern enterprise‑wide commercial process standards, facilitating workshops to define challenges, capture requirements, and map global “as‑is” and “to‑be” processes.
* Act as the strategic link between business and IT, partnering across Commercial Excellence, Finance, Operations, and IT to shape solutions, support Salesforce CRM/CPQ initiatives, and manage UAT and deployment.
* Strengthen global commercial systems and data governance, overseeing Salesforce CRM, CPQ, master data, and champion networks across all business units.
* Drive change, adoption, and governance by delivering training, documentation, and stakeholder engagement while promoting compliance, accountability, and ethical business practices.

Your Profile
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* 4–7 years of experience in business process analysis, preferably in B2B commercial environments
* Strong understanding of sales and service workflows across multiple business units
* Proficiency in process mapping and continuous improvement methodologies
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce, SAP SD, CPQ, and BI tools
* Any Salesforce Certification (Administration, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or CPQ specialist) will be preferred.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in a global context
* Fluent in English; additional languages (e.g., German, French) are a plus

What we offer you
  
  

* Strategic role in shaping Sulzer’s global commercial transformation
* Exposure to diverse functions, cultures, and business units
* Opportunities for professional growth and innovation
* Competitive compensation and benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
  
  
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

title: D2P Solution Consultant - Source to Procure
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
Are you passionate about transforming procurement processes through technology and data? Join Roche and play a key role in shaping the future of our global ERP landscape.
  
  
As a Senior ERP Solution Consultant, you will partner with business and IT stakeholders to design and deliver innovative solutions across the Source-to-Procure (S2P) lifecycle. You will bridge business needs with technical capabilities, driving efficiency, data integrity, and digital transformation across procurement processes.
  
  
This is a highly visible role where you will contribute to global initiatives, influence solution design, and support the evolution of Roche’s procurement ecosystem.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end analysis and solution design across the Source-to-Procure lifecycle, including sourcing, contracting, purchasing, and invoicing
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and user stories
* Act as a functional expert for procurement platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Ariba, Coupa, GEP), ensuring system stability and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, and IT to deliver integrated solutions
* Drive testing activities (SIT, UAT) and ensure high-quality, business-ready system deployments
* Support product and roadmap discussions, balancing quick wins with long-term system sustainability
* Contribute to process optimization, data quality, and user adoption through training and change management

**Who You Are**
You bring a strong mix of functional expertise, problem-solving skills, and stakeholder management:
  
  

* 6–8 years of experience in ERP solution consulting or business analysis within procurement or Source-to-Pay environments
* Hands-on experience with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, Coupa, GEP, or similar
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Source-to-Procure / Procure-to-Pay processes
* Experience translating business needs into technical requirements and implementation plans
* Familiarity with system integrations, APIs, or middleware solutions is an advantage
* Ability to work in agile environments and manage multiple priorities
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:
**Ready to evolve HPS from chat to agentic productivity at global scale?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Role**
This Director level role oversees the engineering organisation for HSBC Productivity Suite (HPS) - a portfolio of AI-enabled productivity solutions used by colleagues across the bank. You’ll own delivery, operational performance and the technical evolution of HPS including the transition from a primarily chat-based solution towards more agentic and autonomous capabilities. The role covers around 50 engineers across the UK, China, India and Poland with around 6-7 team leads reporting directly. Working in partnership with Product and the wider Technology organisation you’ll translate roadmap priorities into secure, scalable and well controlled production outcomes. Success means valuable personal-agent capabilities delivered for colleagues alongside stronger engineering pace, quality and operational performance in a regulated environment.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee delivery of the HPS engineering roadmap in partnership with Product and wider Technology
* Steer the transition of HPS towards personal-agent and agentic AI capabilities
* Set technical direction across applications, AI and Agentic AI, platforms, architecture, data, APIs and developer tooling
* Deliver secure, scalable, reliable and resilient production systems with strong support, monitoring and incident management
* Embed engineering practices across design, testing, automation, DevSecOps and observability to improve pace and quality while managing cost
* Maintain robust technology, privacy, model-risk, cyber, compliance and operational controls
* Build and sustain an inclusive global engineering organisation across the UK, China, India and Poland including team structure and ways of working
* Develop technical talent through coaching, role modelling and clear expectations for engineering standards and delivery outcomes
* Make technology choices that remain relevant as the AI landscape evolves balancing innovation with responsible AI and production standards

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial hands-on software engineering experience turning concepts into enterprise-grade products
* Show proven experience delivering and operating large-scale AI-enabled production systems including GenAI applications
* Demonstrate expertise in LLM-based applications, personal agents, agentic workflows and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Apply practical experience with model evaluation, safety guardrails and responsible AI in production
* Use hands-on engineering skills across Python, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud platforms, containers and Kubernetes
* Establish DevSecOps, automated testing, observability and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices for reliable production operations
* Set architecture, engineering standards and technical direction for complex systems with clear trade-offs and operational accountability
* Manage delivery across distributed, multi-country engineering teams and partner with Product Owners on roadmaps and measurable outcomes

**Building Agentic Productivity at HSBC**
HPS is on a clear journey from chat-based assistance to personal-agent capabilities that help colleagues get more done with less friction. This role shapes the engineering direction and delivery that makes that transition real and safe at scale. You’ll work closely with Product to turn priorities into robust production outcomes while strengthening engineering pace, quality and operational performance. If you want to build agentic AI capabilities that are secure, well controlled and genuinely useful for colleagues we’d welcome your application.
  
  
Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.
  
  
If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com .

Top 3 Skills
  
  

* SAP S/4HANA Source-to-Pay Solution Leadership

Strong experience leading end-to-end S/4HANA Source-to-Pay processes including Procurement, Inventory Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Supplier Management, Data Migration, Testing, Deployment, and Hypercare.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Integration Expertise

Deep understanding of integration between SAP STP and Finance (FI/AP), Controlling, Manufacturing, Quality Management (QM), Sales & Distribution, Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and external procurement systems.

Proven ability to lead fit-to-standard workshops, manage solution design decisions, coordinate functional and technical teams, resolve cross-functional issues, and effectively communicate with business and program leadership.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Source-to-Pay (STP) Lead to lead the design and implementation of end-to-end procurement, inventory management, and invoice verification processes as part of a global SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementation program.
  
  
The STP Lead will be responsible for solution design, configuration, integration, data migration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization while ensuring alignment with SAP Best Practices and business objectives. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, enterprise architecture, integration teams, finance, manufacturing, warehousing, and IT leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead fit-to-standard workshops and drive adoption of SAP S/4HANA Best Practices.
* Own end-to-end Source-to-Pay solution design and configuration.
* Design and implement procurement, inventory management, and logistics invoice verification processes.
* Lead business process harmonization and global template development.
* Manage cross-functional integration with RTR, OTC, Manufacturing & QM, EWM, and external systems.
* Define and review functional requirements for reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, and integrations.
* Lead procurement approval processes utilizing SAP Flexible Workflow.
* Support Fiori-enabled business processes and user experience requirements.
* Manage STP data migration activities including mapping, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and cutover execution.
* Lead SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover rehearsals, and production smoke testing.
* Prepare solution design documents, functional specifications, configuration documentation, process flows, and training materials.
* Support deployment, hypercare, issue resolution, and transition to support organizations.
* Mentor junior consultants and coordinate onshore/offshore delivery teams.

**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of SAP Procurement/Materials Management experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of SAP S/4HANA implementation experience.
* At least two full-cycle SAP implementations, including one S/4HANA implementation.
* Proven experience leading an STP workstream through design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Strong expertise in:
* Organizational Structure
* Material Master & Business Partner Master Data
* Purchasing Processes
* Contracts & Scheduling Agreements
* Direct and Indirect Procurement
* Service Procurement
* Subcontracting & Consignment
* Stock Transport Orders
* Inventory Management
* Batch Management
* Physical Inventory
* Logistics Invoice Verification
* Flexible Workflow
* Strong experience with SAP Activate methodology and Fit-to-Standard workshops.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA data migration, reconciliation, and cutover planning.
* Experience working with RICEFW objects, APIs, IDocs, EDI, and integration technologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with RISE with SAP Private Cloud or Public Cloud.
* SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification.
* Experience with SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, Central Procurement, or other procurement solutions.
* Experience with global template deployments across multiple regions.
* Knowledge of Embedded Analytics and Fiori applications for procurement and inventory processes.

**Success Profile**
The ideal candidate is a results-oriented SAP leader who can drive business transformation, challenge non-standard requirements, promote SAP Best Practices, and successfully deliver a scalable, supportable, and globally integrated Source-to-Pay solution on SAP S/4HANA.
