title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**
Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline (BCA, MCA, B.Tech from an accredited institution). Open to hire from Commerce background given strong technical acumen or expertise of implementation.
  
  

* 4–7 years of software implementation or delivery experience, preferably within the B2B SaaS sector, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity.
* Proven ability to lead complex, enterprise-level software implementations across multiple products and ERP/ecommerce environments.
* Strong ability to articulate process logic and technical architecture — including design and delivery of functional and technical presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of accounting and tax processes, including sales and use tax compliance automation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment.
* Experience contributing to practice improvement — documenting business processes, designing best practices, or owning team-level standards.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — takes initiative at a team level, holds peers accountable with coaching (not criticism), and drives outcomes without requiring direction.
* Embodies Avalara's Success Traits: Ownership, Simplicity, Curiosity, Adaptability, Urgency, Optimism, and Humility.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience configuring or integrating enterprise ERPs such as NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce Commerce, Sage, or WooCommerce.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Jira, or equivalent CRM and project tracking platforms.
* Prior exposure to tax automation software implementation or tax-related roles.
* Experience in NPI or product launch support — working alongside Product Management or Engineering to prepare implementation teams for new releases.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or developing junior team members.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
* Brings data, structure, and strategic thinking to conversations about risk, prioritization, process design, and escalation.
* Challenges assumptions respectfully and proposes better approaches — even when it's uncomfortable.
* Leaves every customer engagement, process, team interaction, and system in a measurably stronger state than they found it.
* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.
* Demonstrates strong judgment in tradeoff decisions, especially when they affect customers, timelines, or team capacity.

Being a Bar Raiser at the I3 level means raising the entire team's execution quality — not just excelling individually.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Automation Excellence Lead
description:
**Maersk Position Description**

* Business Title : Automation Excellence Lead
* Job level : JL4
* Department or Business Unit: Automation Excellence
* Supervisory Responsibilities: No
* Reports to: Head of Automation Excellence

**About The Role**
The Automation Excellence Lead is responsible for driving the design, development, and deployment of next-generation AI-enabled solutions that transform how business processes operate across GSC. The role combines expertise in Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Workflow Automation, and Process Transformation to create scalable, intelligent, and autonomous business capabilities.
  
  
The role serves as a technical leader, solution architect, and innovation catalyst, partnering with business stakeholders, Product Owners, technology teams and SMEs to translate business challenges into AI-powered enterprise solutions. The position is expected to lead complex automation and AI initiatives while mentoring teams and establishing best practices for enterprise AI adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**AI & Intelligent Automation Strategy**

* Drive adoption of AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities across business processes.
* Identify opportunities to transform manual and rule-based activities into intelligent autonomous workflows.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend enterprise adoption strategies.
* Contribute to the AI and automation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases and business transformation opportunities.

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect enterprise-grade automation and AI solutions using Power Platform, Python, Azure AI Services, Copilot Studio, OpenAI, and related technologies.
* Design scalable AI architectures including RAG, multi-agent systems, autonomous AI workflows, intelligent document processing, conversational AI, and process intelligence solutions.
* Define integration strategies across enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge platforms, and workflow systems.
* Create reusable solution patterns, frameworks, components, and technical blueprints to accelerate delivery.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Development**

* Design and develop enterprise GenAI solutions leveraging LLMs and foundation models.
* Build intelligent AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, orchestrating, and executing business activities.
* Develop multi-agent ecosystems supporting end-to-end business processes.
* Create AI copilots and digital assistants for operations, customer support, productivity, decision intelligence, and employee self-service.
* Establish reusable agent frameworks, prompt libraries, connectors, and orchestration patterns.

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex automation and AI initiatives from discovery to production adoption.
* Provide technical guidance, solution architecture oversight, and design review across projects.
* Establish coding standards, AI development standards, reusable frameworks, and quality engineering practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, solution governance assessments, and technical risk evaluations.
* Mentor developers and AI engineers on emerging technologies, technical design, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices.

**Innovation & Capability Building**

* Drive experimentation with emerging AI technologies through proofs of concept, pilots, and rapid prototypes.
* Promote AI awareness, adoption, and practical use case identification across business functions.
* Contribute to AI community of practice, Automation Excellence standards, and Center of Excellence initiatives.
* Support capability-building programs for AI, automation, prompt engineering, agentic design, and responsible AI.

title: Senior Product Manager (Security Domain)
description:
**Job Title: Senior Product Manager**

This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.

**About SailPoint**

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less. Built on a foundation of AI and ML, our Identity Security Cloud Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time—matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud-oriented, modern enterprise.

**About the role**

Imagine starting your day collaborating with world-class engineers and product designers to define foundational, shared capabilities that power a global enterprise security platform. As a Senior Product Manager on our newly formed shared services team, you will play a vital role in shaping the future of our platform by contributing directly to SailPoint's vision for shared capabilities. Your day-to-day will involve shepherding innovative micro-services and SaaS platform connectivity technologies from discovery to release. You will act as the strategic link between Product Management, Design, and Engineering to conceptualize, design, and deliver high-quality, scalable foundational services that directly power the entire SailPoint product portfolio in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**About the team**

The Product Management team at SailPoint is a group of collaborative, results-oriented problem-solvers who thrive on turning complex business needs into clear, actionable plans. We partner with internal and external stakeholders to uncover real challenges, ideate alongside cross-functional partners, and deliver elegant solutions that make a meaningful impact. Our culture values strategic thinking, customer empathy, and a drive to innovate—always with the user and business value at the center of everything we do.

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in a product management role.
* A compelling track record of working with engineering teams to plan, develop, refine, and launch successful enterprise software products.
* Extensive experience managing SaaS and/or cloud infrastructure products.
* Experience with open platform connectivity technologies such as web and micro-services is a plus.

* Exceptional judgment in applying product management principles and processes to solve complex business challenges.
* Outstanding interpersonal, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* An experimental and innovative mindset, with a willingness to embrace new ideas and incorporate feedback to continuously improve our products.
* This position requires approximately 15% travel.

​

**Roadmap for success**

* 30 days:

  + Build relationships with peer Product Managers and Engineering stakeholders.
  + Familiarize yourself with the shared services vision and the specific problem areas you'll be addressing.
  + Actively participate in team meetings to understand the current product backlog and priorities.
* 60 days:

  + Collaborate with Product and Engineering to refine requirements and deliver production-ready work.
  + Engage with stakeholders to scope work, understand its impact, and gain consensus.
  + Begin contributing to the product roadmap and backlog prioritization.
* 6 months:

  + Drive the development and release of new services based on your product vision.
  + Shepherd features through the entire development lifecycle, from planning to launch readiness.
  + Define and track key metrics to measure the success and adoption of new deliverables against business goals.
* 1 year:

  + Collaborate with leadership to significantly influence the design and product strategy for your areas of responsibility.
  + Identify and experiment with new solutions to shape the future of the SailPoint platform.
  + Gather production feedback to create a data-driven product backlog.

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.

Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**Technical Product Manager- Doto Health**

**Location:**

Pune (Work From Office)

**Type:**

Permanent

**Experience:**

3–5 years

**About Doto Health:**

Doto Health
builds technology-driven solutions that make healthcare more accessible and improve health outcomes, with a strong focus on women's and newborn health through CareMother. We combine AI-powered monitoring, connected medical devices and software platforms to enable early detection, preventive care and seamless monitoring, from conception through newborn care, with emphasis on high-risk pregnancy, fetal health, labour and neonatal care.

We equip healthcare providers with tools that foster safer, more informed care, and we work hand in hand with clinicians, public health systems and communities on the ground to make sure what we build actually works in the real world.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a passionate builder to join us as a Product Manager. This is not a single-product, narrow-lane role. You will be flexible across the spectrum at Doto Health, moving between hardware and devices, AI/ML capabilities, software platforms and field programs wherever the business needs you most.

You will own problems end to end: getting out into the field to understand users, turning insights into clear product direction, working with engineering, design, data science and clinical teams to ship, and then going back to the field to validate. We are looking for someone who goes above and beyond, takes ownership without being asked, and is energised by building from 0 to 1.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Discover and validate on the ground:**

  Conduct user research, usability testing and design research in clinics, hospitals, and rural and semi-urban settings to understand user needs, workflows and pain points. Validate every major product decision in the field.
* **Own the product lifecycle:**

  Take products and features from concept validation through development, pilot, launch and scalable deployment, across hardware, software and AI-enabled solutions.
* **Translate insight into product:**

  Convert user insights, field learnings and technical requirements into clear product specifications, user stories and PRDs, and maintain prioritised roadmaps.
* **Work closely with technical teams:**

  Collaborate with engineering, design, data science and clinical teams on brainstorming, technical architecture, feasibility assessment and project planning.
* **Apply AI to your own work:**

  Use LLMs and AI tools in day-to-day product work, such as research synthesis, spec writing, data analysis, prototyping and workflow automation, and help the team do the same.
* **Manage external stakeholders:**

  Build and maintain relationships with clinicians, hospitals, government and public health departments, NGOs, channel partners and vendors to gather requirements, align on needs and drive adoption.
* **Research the market:**

  Carry out market research and competitive analysis to find opportunities, validate product-market fit and inform strategy.
* **Be data-informed:**

  Define and monitor KPIs for product performance, user adoption and clinical impact. Analyse usage data, system logs, surveys and field feedback to identify trends and guide decisions.
* **Support implementation in the field:**

  Travel to field locations to coordinate pilots and rollouts, observe real-world usage, support user training and troubleshoot issues.
* **Be flexible across the portfolio:**

  Pick up different products, initiatives and cross-functional problems as priorities evolve at Doto Health.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Public Health, Health Informatics or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in product management, preferably in health-tech, digital health, medical devices or hardware-enabled products.
* Demonstrated experience taking a product or major feature from idea to launch, with a clear understanding of the end-to-end product development process.
* Technical fluency: able to engage meaningfully with hardware, firmware, AI/ML components, data pipelines and system integration, and to hold your own in architecture and feasibility discussions. You do not need to be a software developer.
* Hands-on experience using applied AI (LLMs and AI tools) to get work done faster and better.
* Strong user research, design research and market research skills, with the ability to synthesise insights into compelling product requirements.
* Proven ability to manage external stakeholders, including clinicians, partners, vendors and, ideally, government or public health bodies.
* Willingness and comfort to travel frequently to the field for validation, pilots and training, including rural and semi-urban locations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Pune, and comfortable working from office.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience in medical technology or medical devices, such as ultrasound, portable diagnostic devices or connected hardware (a strong bonus).
* Familiarity with healthcare delivery systems in India, especially public health ecosystems.
* Proficiency in Hindi for effective field engagement.
* Working knowledge of data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL or Python.
* Understanding of medical device regulatory and quality considerations.

**What are we looking for**

* A
  **builder**

  who would rather ship and learn than plan endlessly.
* **Passionate**

  about using technology to solve real health challenges in India.
* Someone who
  **goes above and beyond**

  , and sees gaps as opportunities to step in.
* **Curious and adaptable**

  , comfortable switching context across products and problem types.
* Happiest
  **in the field**

  with users, not only behind a desk.

**What we offer:**

* The chance to drive high-impact health initiatives with tangible societal benefit.
* Work at the intersection of hardware, AI and real-world healthcare.
* Exposure across the full spectrum of Doto Health's products and programs.
* Collaboration with researchers, engineers, clinicians and public health experts.
* Deep, hands-on experience of India's ground-level health delivery systems.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful work, and the opportunity to build products that truly save lives.

Graduate, Post Graduate – MBA

Graduation with 6 to 8 years and MBA with 5-7 years of relevant experience in driving MFI JLG business in local geo

* Affirmative in nature, Strong Leadership Skills, Clarity of thought and perseverance.

title: AVP - Delivery Manager
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  

* To work collaboratively with colleagues and take personal accountability to maintain and enhance controls you are responsible for to support improvement of the overall control environment, customers outcomes and a reduction in M&G plc's operational risk.
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned squad(s) or workstreams, from demand and initiation through planning, execution, release and closure, with clear accountability for delivery confidence, delivery health and outcome achievement.
* Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, success measures, priorities, scope boundaries and acceptance expectations.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, release forecasts and milestones; communicate confidence, assumptions, options and trade-offs in business language, including the impact of delivery choices on cost, capacity, scope, risk and timelines.
* Manage Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective; ensure each sprint has a clear goal, realistic commitment and actionable improvement outcomes.
* Coach teams in Scrum and Lean practices as appropriate, while protecting team self-organisation and avoiding command-and-control task allocation.
* Ensure backlogs and work items meet the agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and that Jira data provides reliable traceability and delivery insight.
* Actively manage RAID, cross-team dependencies, decisions, blockers, resource constraints and third-party commitments; escalate early with clear impact and recovery options.
* Orchestrate delivery across squads, platforms and workstreams by managing decision flow, cross-squad dependencies, sequencing constraints and delivery assurance activities.
* Use evidence and metrics such as predictability, throughput, cycle time, ageing work, escaped defects, release outcomes and team improvement trends to guide decisions.
* Track delivery against intended benefits, measurable value, business outcomes and agreed success criteria, ensuring progress is visible beyond activity completion.
* Coordinate release readiness across testing, architecture, security, risk, change, service management and application support, including operational handover, runbooks, monitoring, support contacts and known issues.
* Maintain transparent stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, governance updates, demonstrations and decision forums, ensuring no surprises; own delivery input into senior governance forums, steering updates, escalation discussions and leadership reporting where required.
* Promote quality, resilience, security, regulatory compliance and control adherence throughout the delivery lifecycle, including ownership of change-control readiness, audit evidence and regulatory delivery obligations where applicable.
* Facilitate/participate in Scrum of Scrums or equivalent dependency forums where required and contribute to delivery standards, templates, communities of practice and continuous improvement, with focus on portfolio/workstream alignment, delivery risk visibility and consistent delivery assurance practices.
* Create an inclusive, psychologically safe and accountable team environment where constructive challenge, learning and feedback are encouraged.
* Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and delivery colleagues and share reusable practices across the delivery community.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Tech S and T- Tech Strategy - Senior consultant-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 5+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 5+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager Product Software Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Software Engineering**
**Role Summary**
The Senior Manager, Software Engineering is responsible for leading and scaling high‑performing product engineering teams while driving technical excellence, timely delivery, and strategic innovation. This role requires strong people leadership, deep technical expertise, cross‑functional collaboration, and the ability to leverage modern engineering practices including AI‑assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product Management, UX, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to define and execute product roadmaps, contribute to long‑term technical strategy, and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Leadership & People Management**

* Lead and manage a sizable, distributed team of software engineers, fostering a positive, inclusive, and high‑performing culture.
* Provide strong technical and managerial leadership, offering guidance on complex engineering challenges and critical decision‑making.
* Mentor, coach, and develop engineering managers and individual contributors, supporting career growth and succession planning.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide actionable feedback, and identify development opportunities.
* Build trust within teams by setting clear expectations, ensuring accountability, and promoting transparency.

**Delivery & Execution Excellence**

* Plan, prioritize, and schedule work to ensure efficient resource utilization and predictable delivery.
* Ensure timely delivery of projects while balancing scope, quality, risk, and resources.
* Monitor development processes, framework adoption, and project progress to ensure adherence to engineering standards and best practices.
* Estimate project cost, effort, and resource needs; allocate resources effectively across initiatives.
* Continuously monitor ongoing processes and outcomes, providing feedback and driving improvements.

**Technical & Architectural Leadership**

* Drive engineering best practices across code quality, testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.
* Contribute to architectural decisions and long‑term technical strategy aligned with business goals.
* Ensure strong understanding and application of modern software architecture, cloud technologies, and scalable system design.
* Provide oversight and guidance on DevOps practices, microservices architecture, and platform engineering.
* Promote automation across development, testing, deployment, and operational workflows.

**AI Tools & Modern Engineering Practices**

* Drive adoption of AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, code review assistance, test automation, DevOps intelligence).
* Leverage AI tools to improve developer productivity, reduce cycle time, enhance code quality, and accelerate troubleshooting.
* Encourage responsible and secure usage of AI tools in engineering workflows, following organizational and compliance guidelines.
* Use data and AI‑driven insights to improve delivery predictability, quality metrics, and engineering efficiency.
* Stay informed on emerging AI trends and assess their applicability to product engineering and platform evolution.

**Stakeholder & Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Communicate effectively in a matrixed organization with senior leadership, stakeholders, and cross‑functional partners.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, UX, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to define, prioritize, and execute product roadmaps.
* Partner across teams, geographies, and functions to enable smooth integrations and successful product launches.
* Influence without authority and resolve dependencies across teams to ensure alignment and progress.

**Required Skills & Expertise**
**Core Technical & Engineering Skills**

* Product Software Engineering: Strong expertise in designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable software products.
* Cloud Computing: Hands‑on understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), cloud‑native architectures, and managed services.
* DevOps: Experience with automation, CI/CD, continuous delivery, monitoring, and rapid feedback loops.
* Software Architecture: Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and platform engineering.
* APIs & Integrations: Experience designing, securing, documenting, and managing APIs.
* Automation: Expertise in designing and optimizing automated systems across SDLC.
* Frameworks: Strong knowledge of modern development frameworks and best practices.

**Ways of Working**

* Agile Methodologies: Experience leading teams using Agile/Scrum/Kanban with a strong focus on continuous improvement.
* Implementation & Delivery: Proven ability to execute plans effectively and deliver complex initiatives.
* Problem Solving & Analysis: Ability to break down complex problems and develop practical, scalable solutions.
* Spec Driven development
* AI oriented SDLC

**People & Leadership Skills**

* People Management: Strong skills in coaching, delegation, conflict resolution, motivation, and performance management.
* Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Influence & Collaboration: Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment.

**Competencies & Leadership Behaviours**

* Judgement & Decision Making
* Accountability & Ownership
* Inclusive Collaboration
* Inspiration & Alignment
* Courage to Take Smart Risks

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience leading multi‑team or multi‑location engineering organizations.
* Exposure to AI/ML‑powered engineering platforms or developer productivity tools.
* Experience in large‑scale product organizations or SaaS platforms.

Our Interview Practices

Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. title: Manager, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Merchant Cloud and Acceptance represent core strategic priorities for the Asia Pacific region. Our mission is to empower acquirers, merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), and payment facilitators by delivering seamless, best-in-class experiences across both digital and in-person commerce. We aim to position Mastercard Merchant Cloud as the leading platform for acceptance.
  
  
As an integral part of Mastercard’s regional growth strategy, this role will support sales initiatives across Asia Pacific. Key responsibilities include conducting market research and benchmarking, contributing to go-to-market planning, supporting solution commercialization, and engaging in client-related activities. The individual will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Product, Operations, Delivery, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and other internal partners—to drive execution and deliver strategic outcomes.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the identification and assessment of potential opportunities for Merchant Cloud across APAC through data analysis and insight generation.
* Conduct customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify indicators of expansion, cross-sell, or product adoption potential
* Analyze transaction characteristics and market data to support identification of relevant customer segments
* Develop and maintain analytical frameworks and reporting models including opportunity sizing approaches, funnel and conversion analytics, and pipeline coverage metrics for internal monitoring and decision-support purposes.
* Build and maintain integrated analytical datasets and internal insight packs by combining data sources for internal analysis.
* Integrate diverse data inputs to generate analytical insights and structured outputs that may indicate high-potential customers segments and support internal prioritization discussions.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to provide analytical support and validate data assumptions; does not involve participation in commercial decision-making or execution.
* Provide data backed insights, benchmarking and analytical inputs to support value propositions by relevant team, ensuring Mastercard’s differentiation in the Merchant Cloud and Acceptance space.
* Analyse client trends and develop reports and dashboards to provide visibility and support internal decision-making and performance monitoring.
* Partner with internal technology and core payments teams to support pipeline generation through various data sources, reporting and opportunity sizing models.

**All About You**

* Experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce in APAC, ideally with exposure to acquirers, PSPs, merchants, or acceptance ecosystems.
* Strong data analysis capability, including advanced Excel (mandatory) and Tableau or Power BI (preferred).
* Proven ability to work with multi-source datasets and synthesize them into clear, practical outputs.
* Experience supporting multi-market proposition launches, including pipeline dashboards, account-level analysis, and business insights that inform commercial decision-making.
* Ability to translate data into simple, compelling narratives for non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, self-starter mentality, and strong problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and the ability to create structure within a matrix organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Tech S and T- TechStrategy-Senior Manager-GDSF04
description:

title: Engineering Product Manager
description:
**Meet the Team**
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
**Your Impact**
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
  
  
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a technically strong and execution-oriented Technical Product Manager to help advance the Windchill+ SaaS platform. The role partners closely with Product Management, Platform R&D, Quality Assurance, Cloud Engineering, and service operations teams to translate platform requirements into well-defined, executable development backlogs.
  
  
The immediate focus is platform release execution performed directly with R&D teams. This includes release readiness, technical improvements, security and compliance changes, infrastructure evolution, validation, retrofitting, and other work required to advance and maintain the platform. The TPM will operate under the mentorship of the lead Windchill+ Platform TPM while progressively assuming ownership of recurring backlog, dependency, and release-management responsibilities.
  
  
Over time, the role will expand into broader service-level improvements. The TPM will help define how platform capabilities affect the Windchill+ service experience and will apply Design for Operations thinking earlier in the development lifecycle. Design for Operations is an evolving practice within the organization, and this role will help establish practical ways to incorporate operational requirements, installed-base impacts, customer enablement, and service readiness into backlog definition.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The responsibilities below represent a superset of the work this role may perform. Actual day-to-day focus will vary over the course of any given release and across releases. The TPM is not expected to perform all of these responsibilities all of the time, or to do so without support from the broader team.
  
  

* Partner directly with Windchill+ Platform R&D teams to define, refine, prioritize, and maintain executable product backlogs.
* Translate product, service, security, compliance, and operational requirements into clear deliverables, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and release outcomes.
* Own day-to-day TPM execution for assigned platform initiatives through discovery, planning, development, validation, and release.
* Coordinate platform readiness for Windchill product releases, maintenance releases, security updates, supporting component changes, and installed-base retrofits.
* Work with engineering and QA leads to assess technical approaches, dependencies, resource needs, delivery estimates, validation requirements, and release feasibility.
* Lead backlog refinement and support sprint planning, PI planning, release planning, story acceptance, and TPM readouts with globally distributed Agile teams.
* Manage work across Product Management, Platform R&D, QA, Cloud Engineering, operations, integrated products, and shared services, converting dependencies into explicit backlog and accountable ownership.
* Facilitate technical discovery and design spikes when requirements, architecture, or operational impacts are not sufficiently understood.
* Maintain a reliable view of planned, completed, deferred, and at-risk work; identify decisions and escalations early enough to protect delivery.
* Balance urgent tactical needs with longer-term platform objectives and roadmap priorities.
* Begin applying Design for Operations to assigned work by considering provisioning, configuration, monitoring, support, maintenance, security, upgrades, retrofitting, validation, and customer enablement during backlog definition.
* Continuously strengthen technical and product-management expertise through hands-on collaboration, mentoring, and formal or self-directed learning.

Growth Opportunities
  
  
As experience and organizational practices mature, the TPM will expand from hands-on platform execution into broader service-level ownership:
  
  

* Independently manage multiple platform workstreams across releases, including more complex cross-team and installed-base changes.
* Lead selected Design for Operations assessments and help evolve the organization's methods, templates, and working practices.
* Define how proposed capabilities change the experience for customers, administrators, partners, support teams, and service operators.
* Own selected service improvements from definition through release, connecting the intended service experience to the required platform, automation, documentation, enablement, and operational backlog.
* Partner with the Offering Owner on changes that affect the Service Guide, service catalog, customer commitments, or broader offering definition.
* Provide broader Windchill+ TPM coverage, enabling the lead platform TPM to concentrate on strategic, cross-offering, and technically complex initiatives.

Skills and Knowledge
  
  
**Required**

* Strong experience with enterprise software development, platform engineering, cloud services, DevOps, systems integration, or SaaS delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical and business requirements into an executable Agile backlog.
* Experience writing deliverables, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.
* Experience prioritizing backlogs and performing story or release acceptance.
* Working knowledge of Scrum, Agile planning, backlog refinement, and iterative software delivery.
* Ability to understand complex technical dependencies and drive decisions across multiple engineering and stakeholder teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, architects, QA engineers, operations teams, Product Managers, and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining alignment across globally distributed teams.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, science, mathematics, or an equivalent technical discipline.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Windchill installation, deployment, administration, integrations, or functional capabilities.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure or other public or private cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, Docker, Kubernetes, or enterprise application deployment technologies.
* Familiarity with Java-based enterprise application architectures, REST APIs, scripting, Linux, and secure communication technologies.
* Experience with Jira or similar requirements and backlog management systems.
* Understanding of application security, compliance, identity and access management, monitoring, and operational validation.
* Experience supporting SaaS releases, platform updates, maintenance releases, security updates, or installed-base retrofits.
* Exposure to service design, operational readiness, or product-to-operations transition practices.

**Experience**

* Typically 6 or more years of relevant experience in enterprise software development, technical product management, engineering delivery, cloud services, systems integration, deployment, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Formal Product Manager or Product Owner experience is valuable but is not required when the candidate has demonstrated ownership of complex technical delivery and engineering backlog.
* Experience coordinating work across multiple teams or systems is strongly preferred.
* The candidate should be comfortable starting in a hands-on execution role and growing into broader service-level ownership.

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
  
  
If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
  
  
We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

NA
  
  

* ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE

To own and drive the Asset Cross-Sell business for the assigned region by delivering disbursement targets across retail asset products through the Branch Banking channel. The role is responsible for regional business planning and execution, sales strategy, campaign and contest management, stakeholder engagement, performance governance and execution of strategic initiatives to maximize business growth. The role also drives relationship deepening by ensuring customers acquired through Asset Cross-Sell are effectively cross-sold Liability Products, Third Party Products (TPP), Digital Banking and other relevant Bank offerings.
