title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

organization — and we are building one of the most

title: Specialist, Financial Planning & Analysis Representative
description:
**Job Description**
**Specialist, Financial Planning & Analysis Representative**
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Specialist, Financial Planning & Analysis Representative to join our Finance team. This role is located in Pune.
  
  
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
Partner with CFO, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, Risk, Data and Technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into clearly defined requirements.
  
  
Support requirements elicitation, analysis and documentation across Finance and Treasury initiatives.
  
  
Translate business and regulatory requirements into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional and data requirements, with guidance where needed.
  
  
Perform impact analysis across business processes, data flows, systems, and downstream regulatory and management reporting.
  
  
Analyse financial data using SQL and other analytical tools to support requirements definition, investigation and validation.
  
  
Document and validate data requirements, including data elements, business rules, transformations, mappings, lineage and reconciliation requirements.
  
  
Identify data-quality issues and collaborate with business and technology teams on root-cause analysis and sustainable remediation.
  
  
Support solution design by helping confirm that proposed technology and data solutions meet business and control objectives.
  
  
Develop test scenarios and acceptance criteria, and support business validation and user acceptance testing (UAT) through implementation.
  
  
Maintain traceability from business requirements through solution delivery and testing.
  
  
Identify dependencies, risks, assumptions and issues, and escalate or work with the appropriate stakeholders to support resolution.
  
  
Communicate business and data concepts clearly to business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
  
**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**
A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Data or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  
  
3–5 years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst within banking, financial services or another complex financial environment.
  
  
Experience supporting change across Finance, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, Risk or Data functions.
  
  
Practical capability in requirements elicitation, process analysis, functional decomposition, impact assessment, gap analysis, business rules, process mapping and requirements traceability.
  
  
Hands-on SQL capability is strongly preferred, together with experience in data profiling, mapping, lineage, reconciliation and data-quality analysis.
  
  
Demonstrated experience working within Agile delivery models, including epics, features and user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement and prioritisation, sprint planning, sprint reviews and demonstrations, and user acceptance testing and release readiness.
  
  
Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure and analyse business problems.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels.
  
  
Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to ask questions and challenge assumptions constructively.
  
  
The ability to work effectively across business, data and technology teams.
  
  
A high degree of ownership, attention to detail and focus on delivery outcomes.
  
  
The ability to manage priorities and dependencies within an Agile delivery environment.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.

* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Lead AI Engagement Specialist**
owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.
  
  
This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.
  
  
**Where this role sits**
**Reports to:**
Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
**Alignment:**
Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover
  
  
**Works with:**
AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required
  
  
**Owns:**
The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.
  
  
**Accountable for:**
Realised, measured business value — not deployment count
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**
This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.
* Having deployed AI or automation into production and lived with the results — including a deployment that underperformed and what you did about it.
* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience working alongside system integrators or external delivery partners.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.
* Not a role that ends at go-live. Managing agent performance afterwards is a permanent part of the job.

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 months**

* A credible, ranked workflow pipeline for your functions, grounded in real process data and endorsed by function leadership.
* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.
* Baselines established for the metrics your first workflows will move.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How We Assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.
* Stakeholder interview with leadership from the function you would cover.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Associate Director - Data Management
description:
Marsh is seeking a Data Domain Lead to support the strategy, development, and adoption of enterprise data products within an assigned domain. This role will be accountable to turn domain data into trusted, reusable, and business-ready products that support operational processes, analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong business acumen with data experience, partnering across business, technology, architecture, governance, and regional teams to support domain priorities, help maintain authoritative business definitions, and contribute to measurable business value. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a product mindset, strong stakeholder engagement, and the ability to help translate business needs into scalable, governed data solutions.
  
  
**What can you expect?**

* An opportunity to contribute to enterprise data products that support critical business processes and decisions
* Visibility across business, technology, and regional leadership teams
* A highly collaborative role working across architecture, engineering, governance, and operational stakeholders
* The ability to contribute to how data is trusted, reused, and activated across the organization
* An environment focused on business outcomes, measurable value, and enterprise-scale transformation

**What is in it for you?**

* A key contributor role in advancing Marsh's data strategy
* The opportunity to drive real business impact through data product adoption and value realization
* Collaboration with colleagues and cross-functional teams
* Exposure to enterprise architecture, governance, analytics, and AI initiatives
* A culture that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**We will count on you to:**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for an assigned data domain
* Define domain scope, boundaries, and authoritative business definitions
* Translate business needs into reusable, governed domain data products
* Partner with business sponsors, architects, engineers, and governance teams to deliver domain capabilities
* Support management of the domain backlog, release priorities, and product acceptance criteria
* Ensure the domain supports end-to-end business processes, not just individual systems or datasets
* Lead tracer testing across real business transactions to validate data quality, handoffs, identifiers, and usability
* Drive adoption across operational applications, reporting, analytics, self-service, and AI capabilities
* Establish quality, governance, privacy, and control requirements within the product lifecycle
* Assist in coordinating delivery across global and regional teams, including dependencies, milestones, and risks
* Contribute to measuring domain success through trust, reuse, adoption, and business value
* Escalate unresolved issues related to ownership, quality, capacity, and priorities

**What you need to have:**

* Experience in data products, enterprise data, business data strategy, or product management
* Strong knowledge of business process design and translation of business needs into data requirements
* Experience contributing to delivering data capabilities into production and supporting adoption with business stakeholders
* Working knowledge of data architecture, data modeling, metadata, quality, governance, and integration
* Strong stakeholder collaboration skills across business, technology, operations, and regional teams
* Ability to contribute to cross-functional initiatives without relying solely on direct authority
* Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics in clear business language
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity while driving measurable outcomes

**What makes you stand out?**

* Experience in insurance, risk, benefits, financial services, or another complex regulated industry
* A product-oriented mindset with a strong focus on adoption, value realization, and business outcomes
* Experience balancing enterprise consistency with regional and business-specific requirements
* Demonstrated success in identifying and resolving data handoff, ownership, and quality issues across end-to-end processes
* Familiarity with data activation across analytics, reporting, operational platforms, and AI use cases

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: FBS Product Owner III- Guidewire
description:
Takes a fully independent lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks with little to no support with a high volume of work and increased complexity. Utilizes strong understanding of the business vision to to regularly contribute and manage execution. Heavily influences the business owner's requirements, the Product Manager's program vision and roadmap while introducing new and useful tools and practices to drive continuous improvement. Provides overall leadership to Product Owner team through mentorship and guidance and provides back up to Product Manager, as needed.
  
  
**Requirements**
Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes advanced business knowledge, based on prior experience within business function, and communication skills to anticipate problems and address them accordingly. Works cross functionally in a self-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Leads processes and procedure changes identified by teams by working with external business partners. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. Contributes strategic input into the prioritization of the program backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. Drives the mitigation of program risks. Leads PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution. Leads in Inspect & Adapt (I&A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery. title: Engagement Manager
description:
Bit about us

At Progreva, our mission is to be a leading progressive, values-driven organization that transforms the employee experience, whether in the office, at home or wherever our people choose to work. Our employees’ and contractors’ well-being comes first.

We’re building a culture of camaraderie, work-life balance and empathy, where people feel comfortable, confident and empowered, with the ownership, space and autonomy to succeed.

We believe that when we take great care of our people, they take exceptional care of our clients. That’s why we work only with clients who share our employee-centric values. And yes, we also build breakthrough digital products for our global clients, and have fun along the way!

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Engagement Manager**
to lead Progreva’s engagement with a global energy-technology enterprise, delivered through our European delivery partner. The role has three parts:

·      a
**hands-on consultant**
embedded in the client’s IT organisation

·      a
**trusted advisor**
who helps application owners modernise their systems and grows the account

·      the
**people lead**
for the Progreva engineers on the programme

You will help the client’s application managers put their needs into words, show them what modern technology makes possible, and turn that into well-scoped work for our team. You will also build the same consultative, opportunity-spotting mindset in our engineers.

Responsibilities:

Client-facing Business Analysis

·      Work inside the client’s IT organisation as a
**billable business analyst / application consultant**
, first alongside an experienced Progreva consultant, then on your own.

·      Run
**requirement workshops**
with application managers and users, and turn their needs into user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritised backlogs.

·      Create and maintain
**application documentation**
: functional specs, process flows, architecture overviews, user guides and runbooks.

·      Find
**security and compliance gaps**
(penetration-test findings, access management, outdated components) and coordinate the fixes.

Account Growth & Solutioning

·      Map the client’s applications, understand each product’s users and roadmap, and spot pain points early.

·      Shape
**modernisation opportunities**
: .NET upgrades, cloud migration, UX redesign, test automation and QA, AI automation, data platforms, dashboards and analytics.

·      Turn opportunities into
**scoped proposals**
(problem, solution, estimate, business value), and work with Progreva leadership and our delivery partner to turn them into statements of work.

·      
**Coach engineers**
to spot improvement opportunities in their own products, run regular opportunity reviews, and collect each application’s annual roadmap.

·      Maintain the
**account opportunity pipeline**
and report growth progress to Progreva leadership.

Team Management

·      
**Set clear goals and expectations**
, track individual and team performance, and give regular feedback and support for career development.

·      
**Handle escalations**
as the first point of contact for delivery issues, and own
**account growth**
alongside Progreva leadership.

·      Support
**hiring, onboarding, documentation and knowledge transfer**
, so the team keeps the right skills and continuity across locations.

·      Coordinate plans, timelines, dependencies and status reporting so that commitments are
**delivered on time and to quality**
.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

·      Build long-term relationships with application managers, IT leadership and our delivery partner’s account team.

·      Run regular account and service reviews covering delivery, team health, risks and opportunities.

·      
**Travel to Europe**
when needed (up to 1 month per year) for workshops, planning and partner meetings.

An ideal candidate:

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or IT. An MBA is a plus.

**Skills:**

·      
**6–10 years in IT services**
, including 3+ years in a client-facing BA, consultant, project manager or customer success role, and
**2+ years leading a small team**
.

·      A
**proven track record of growing an account**
by finding, scoping and winning follow-on work.

·      Enough
**technical grounding**
to talk credibly with engineers about software development, cloud, databases, APIs, data/BI and application security. No coding is expected.

·      Strong at
**requirements elicitation and documentation**
, using tools such as Jira/Azure DevOps and Confluence.

·      A
**consultative communicator**
with excellent English, comfortable advising senior business and technical stakeholders without overselling.

·      A natural
**people leader**
who sets clear expectations, gives honest feedback and keeps a distributed team motivated.

·      Familiar with Agile/Scrum. CBAP, SAFe PO/PM, PSM/CSM or PMP is a plus.

·      Experience with
**European clients**
, or in the
**energy, utilities, manufacturing or industrial**
domain, is a strong advantage.

·      Comfortable working
**CET hours**
.

What is in it for you?

·      Helping build an employee-centric, values-driven organization

·      Being part of a growing start-up that is setting new standards for employee well-being while delivering breakthrough digital products

·      Working in an international, distributed environment for industry-leading clients

·      A hybrid setup: 3 days a week at our Baner, Pune office and 2 days from home

·      Working as part of a large client organization, with interesting challenges every day, rather than in an “outsourced model”

·      A competitive salary, a performance-based incentive and a
**healthy work-life balance**

·      A
**visible leadership role**
with direct access to the founder and room to grow as the account grows

How to Apply:

Send your resume and a short cover letter explaining your interest in the
**Engagement Manager**
role to hr@progreva.com. During the interview process you’ll also speak with members of our team to learn about our culture and values. We’ll keep interviewing until we find the right person, so if you’ve read this far, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**About Us**
**PBU Delivery & Agile Operations Manager – OMS**
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
**Reports to:**
Product Business Unit Head
  
  
**Experience:**
6+ Years
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time, Work from Office
  
  
**About The Role**
Anchanto is a global enterprise-grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, inventory, marketplaces, fulfilment, parcel tracking, and omnichannel commerce.
  
  
As Anchanto evolves toward integrated Product Business Units (PBUs), we need a leader who can run the delivery operating system of a business unit. This role combines multi-pod Scrum leadership, program delivery, resource and capacity planning, financial visibility, operational governance, and PBU administration.
  
  
This is
**not a ceremony-only Scrum Master role**
. The person is expected to independently create structure, maintain a single view of all commitments, challenge unrealistic plans, hold senior stakeholders accountable, and ensure work gets delivered with speed, predictability, and quality.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
The PBU model brings Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Implementation, and Support closer together around a single product outcome. To make this model work, the PBU needs one owner for delivery rhythm, portfolio visibility, resource loading, risk management, operational discipline, and leadership reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agile Delivery & Scrum Leadership**

* Manage approximately 6-10 active Scrum teams or delivery pods in parallel.
* Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily Scrum, reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums.
* Ensure every pod has a clear sprint goal, ready backlog, acceptance criteria, realistic capacity plan, visible dependencies, and agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.
* Monitor and improve commitment reliability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, scope churn, defect leakage, release predictability, and delivery flow.
* Identify recurring blockers, delayed QA, weak Jira hygiene, and process failures, and drive corrective actions.

**Integrated Delivery & Portfolio Planning**

* Maintain one consolidated delivery plan across product roadmap, customer projects, customisations, technical debt, innovation, compliance requirements, production incidents, and L3 support.
* Maintain visibility of milestones, dependencies, delivery confidence, scope changes, customer commitments, and roadmap displacement.
* Support quarterly planning, monthly operating reviews, and major reprioritisation decisions.

**Resource Loading & Capacity Management**

* Maintain a current capacity and allocation view across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Design, Implementation, and Support.
* Identify overload, underutilisation, shared-resource conflicts, skill bottlenecks, and single points of failure.
* Recommend pod composition and practical trade-off options when capacity is insufficient.
* Track planned versus actual utilisation and explain material variance.

**Delivery Accountability & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as the operating owner for PBU delivery.
* Hold Product Managers, Engineering Managers, QA Leads, Architects, and stakeholders accountable for agreed actions and standards.
* Challenge unrealistic commitments, incomplete requirements, unsupported dates, and unapproved customer promises.
* Escalate unresolved issues with impact, options, recommendations, and decision requirements.

**Financial, Quality & Release Governance**

* Track planned versus actual effort, budget consumption, forecast variance, vendor cost, rework, and support cost.
* Maintain operational cost visibility for major roadmap initiatives and customer projects.
* Create and maintain release-readiness criteria covering functional completion, regression, integration, security, performance, open defects, rollback, monitoring, and support readiness.
* Track defect leakage, production incidents, release failures, and RCA closure.

**PBU Operations & Compliance**

* Coordinate onboarding, role induction, stakeholder introductions, and training for new team members.
* Coordinate employee exits, access revocation, knowledge transfer, and work reassignment.
* Maintain PBU roster, role mapping, allocation view, onboarding status, and knowledge coverage.
* Support ISO, GDPR, information security, customer audits, and compliance obligations.
* Ensure compliance actions, evidence, owners, and due dates are tracked and completed.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Create weekly PBU operating reports covering delivery health, milestones, capacity, roadmap progress, quality, risks, and decisions required.
* Run delivery reviews, dependency reviews, release-readiness reviews, and leadership reviews.
* Ensure Jira, Confluence, RAID logs, decision logs, and dashboards serve as trusted systems of record.
* Drive automation, AI-enabled reporting, and continuous process improvement.

**Skills & Experience**

* 6+ years across software delivery, program management, project management, Agile delivery, product operations, or engineering operations.
* At least 5 years managing Agile software delivery teams.
* Experience managing multiple teams or workstreams in parallel.
* Strong experience in delivery planning, resource loading, capacity management, risk management, dependency management, and release governance.
* Experience influencing Product, Engineering, QA, and customer-facing teams without direct reporting authority.
* Strong Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and executive reporting capability.
* Working knowledge of software development, APIs, CI/CD, testing, production support, and release management.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Enterprise SaaS, B2B Software, OMS, WMS, E-commerce, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Fulfilment domain exposure.
* Experience with customer implementations, product customisation, and roadmap-versus-customer trade-offs.
* Experience managing large cross-functional teams and delivery pods.
* Exposure to ISO, GDPR, SOC2, information security, and customer audit controls.
* Experience with Power BI, Jira Advanced Roadmaps, portfolio management tools, AI-enabled delivery, and workflow automation.
* PMP, PSM, CSM, SAFe, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification.

**What This Role Is Not**

* A ceremony-only Scrum Master role.
* A Jira administrator or meeting coordinator.
* A passive follow-up or status-chasing role.
* A PMO reporting role that presents problems without recommendations.
* A substitute for Product, Engineering, Finance, or Compliance leadership functions.

**Success Measures**

* Multi-pod delivery predictability
* Delivery flow and throughput

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Employee Productivity
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for 30 years. It’s an outstanding legacy of innovation that’s motivated by great technology—and outstanding people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Software Engineering to lead the evolution of our AI-powered employee experiences across web, native mobile, and agentic interfaces. You will build and guide a high-performing engineering team responsible for products that help NVIDIA employees find information, get work done, and navigate personalized, intelligent journeys at global scale. This hands-on leadership role combines people development, product and technical strategy, architecture, and end-to-end operational ownership.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Lead, hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers building employee-facing products across web, native mobile, and agentic AI experiences.
* Define the engineering vision, architecture, multi-quarter roadmap, and success measures for a cohesive employee productivity platform serving a global workforce.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, HR, Security, Privacy, SRE, and enterprise technology teams to translate employee needs into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Plan and manage team execution, including project prioritization, capacity planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, and predictable delivery.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across web and mobile clients, cloud-native services, APIs, data platforms, and enterprise integrations through design reviews, code reviews, and targeted prototypes.
* Drive the delivery of personalized search, knowledge, content, and workflow experiences powered by LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and intelligent agents.
* Establish practices for trustworthy agentic systems, including evaluations, observability, guardrails, identity and access controls, auditability, feedback loops, and human oversight.
* Integrate HRIS, identity, collaboration, knowledge, and productivity platforms to create connected, automated employee journeys.
* Raise the engineering bar for architecture, testing, documentation, CI/CD, maintainability, and developer productivity while guiding teams through complex technical tradeoffs.
* Own the operational health of the team’s products and services, including reliability, performance, incident response, observability, capacity planning, and cost efficiency and ensure security, privacy, accessibility, and responsible AI principles are incorporated throughout product design and development.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering or related fields (or equivalent experience).
* 12+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 6+ years leading and managing high-performing engineering teams.
* A proven record of hiring, retaining, mentoring, and growing engineers, including senior and principal-level technical leaders.
* Demonstrated success delivering consumer-grade web and/or native mobile products at enterprise scale.
* Experience defining technical strategy and leading the architecture and delivery of distributed, full-stack software systems.
* Strong understanding of applied AI technologies such as LLMs, agentic systems, search, recommendation, retrieval, or machine learning-powered product experiences.
* Experience with modern web and mobile development, cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, CI/CD, relational and NoSQL data stores, and production observability.
* Experience operating business-critical services with high standards for reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance.
* Strong product judgment and a record of collaborating effectively with Product, Design, Security, Privacy, SRE, and business stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives around a clear direction.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Led the delivery of production generative AI or agentic products—such as copilots, RAG systems, conversational assistants, or autonomous workflows—to thousands of users.
* Experience building evaluation frameworks, safety guardrails, feedback systems, and governance practices for enterprise AI products.
* Shipped cohesive experiences spanning modern web frameworks and native iOS and/or Android applications.
* Built platforms integrating HRIS, identity, collaboration, knowledge, and productivity ecosystems.
* Successfully scaled engineering teams through rapid growth or significant technical and organizational change, or contributed to open-source AI, search, mobile, web, or developer-platform technologies.

If you're creative, results-oriented and enjoy learning while having fun, then what are you waiting for? Apply today!

* Manage communication plans to ensure stakeholders are informed of release schedules, impacts, outages, and business readiness activities.
* Coordinate incident resolution and rollback activities when required following production deployments.
* Ensure releases comply with enterprise governance, security, audit, and regulatory requirements

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in Release Management, Change Management, or Delivery Management within enterprise technology environments.
* Experience managing releases across Salesforce environments including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce deployment processes, environment management, and release best practices.
* Experience working with:
* Salesforce DevOps processes
* CI/CD pipelines
* Git-based source control
* Automated deployment tools
* Environment strategy and management
* Experience coordinating complex releases involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and technology platforms.
* Strong knowledge of change management, risk management, and governance processes.
* Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools such as:
* Copado
* Gearset
* Salesforce DevOps Center
* AutoRABIT
* Azure DevOps
* Understanding of testing lifecycle activities including SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release validation.
* Experience managing release schedules, dependencies, and production deployment activities within Agile delivery environments.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe Agile.
* Excellent organisational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and competing priorities.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to coordinate senior business and technology leaders during major releases.
* Proven problem-solving skills with the ability to remain calm and decisive during critical deployment activities.
* ITIL Change Management certification or equivalent experience is highly desirable.
* Salesforce certifications or experience within Salesforce platform delivery teams would be beneficial

title: Application Development  Manager - Vice President
description:
The Applications Development Senior Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  

* Strategic Engineering Leadership & Multi-Scrum Governance
* Lead, mentor, and manage multiple cross-functional Scrum teams (Software Engineers, Solution Architects, and QA/Automation Engineers) across globally distributed locations.
* Drive end-to-end delivery accountability across concurrent Books of Work (BOW), ensuring clear milestones, proactive dependency management, and on-time business outcomes.
* Champion engineering excellence, Agile maturity, and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) best practices across all pods under management.
* Conduct personnel management responsibilities including technical coaching, talent acquisition, career development, performance evaluations, and team capacity planning.
* Hands-On Technical Authority & Solution Architecture
* Serve as the senior technical authority for enterprise-scale distributed systems, validating and steering high-level solution designs and low-level architectural patterns.
* Demonstrate active hands-on technical proficiency in Java 21, Spring Boot 4.x, Cloud-Native Microservices, and distributed persistence/messaging architectures.
* Establish and enforce rigorous coding standards, design patterns, automated test coverage gates, and continuous code quality reviews (SonarQube, Snyk).
* Drive architectural modernization initiatives, transitioning legacy frameworks into modular, scalable, event-driven, and containerized services (Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes).
* AI & Agentic Automation Transformation
* Actively drive the adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent autonomous workflows across the development and operational lifecycle.
* Identify repeat, recurring, and boilerplate engineering/operational tasks (e.g., automated code reviews, test generation, schema migrations, log analytics, incident triage) and architect multi-agent or prompt-engineered solutions to automate them.
* Foster a culture of AI-assisted engineering and experimentation within teams while strictly adhering to enterprise AI guardrails, security standards, and governance policies.
* Data Platform & Infrastructure Modernization
* Oversee the architecture and optimization of high-throughput data and reporting pipelines leveraging relational engines (Oracle 19c / OraaS) and distributed document stores (MongoDB 7.x/8.x / MaaS).
* Design and govern high-volume event streaming and messaging fabrics utilizing Apache Kafka and IBM MQ.
* Ensure non-functional requirements (NFRs) such as high availability, fault tolerance, active-active failover, disaster recovery (RTO/RPO), and low-latency response times are rigorously met.

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 10-15 years of relevant experience in the Financial Service industry
* Experience as Applications Development Manager
* Experience as senior level in an Applications Development role
* Stakeholder and people management experience
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Proven project management skills
* Basic knowledge of industry practices and standards
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred
